jobs.title: Translation Program Coordinator - Spanish
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world\-renowned care begins with world\-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family\-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state\-of\-the\-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team \- like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  

  

**Job ID:** LP\_011096\-2240

 **Job Description** **JOB SUMMARY**


This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.


The Translation Program Coordinator is responsible for developing, coordinating and managing translation services, for training and assessment of staff, interns and volunteers for translation services. Conducts medical and general interpreting/translating for staff, patients, and families for Stanford Health Services and other contracting institutions. Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.


Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.


Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Coordinates workflow of all translation assignments, including delegating translation assignments and ensuring successful completion of all assigned projects.
* Develops policies, financial planning and organization of the translation program.
* Edits all translations providing feedback to the translation team including monitoring the translators' performance and providing feedback.
* Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.
* Handles requests for translations from external customers including other hospitals, pharmaceutical companies and outside institutions.
* Communicates and manages the procedure, payment, and delivery timeframe.
* Coordinates with outside contractors for certain languages and establishes working relationships with contractors and vendors.
* Responsible for invoicing, billing and collection upon delivery of final product for external customers.
* Handles requests for translations from the hospital units and clinics and assigns work orders to in house translators.
* Must possess high verbal and written skills in both English and the appropriate language.
* Organizes educational translation meetings and prepares presentations on translation topics such as grammar, punctuation, medical terminology, etc) in staff meetings.
* Performs all functions listed under the job description for translator.
* Responsible for Translation quality including edits to all Spanish translations including format, grammar, syntax, usage, spelling, etc.
* Reviews delivery of assignments of electronic files and ensures fonts are legible (Asian, Arabic, Russian languages).

 **Qualifications** **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in a work\-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.

**Experience:** Three (3\) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Licensure/Certification:** ATA certification required. ATA certification may be waived with a master's degree in Translation.

 **KNOWLEDGE**


These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

* Ability to adjust communications to fit the needs and level of understanding of the receiver.
* Ability to establish and maintain excellent client relationships, exhibit exemplary interpersonal skills and exercise sound judgment and professionalism in business and personnel matters.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and apply sound judgment
* Ability to solve problems and identify solutions.
* Ability to work well with individuals at all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of cultural and perceptual factors that may affect patient treatment and communication Knowledge of Medical Terminology.

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**


The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

 **Additional Information** **Pay Range**  

Compensation is based on the level and requirements of the role.  

Salary within our ranges may also be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.  

Typically, new team members join at the minimum to mid salary range.  

Minimum to Midpoint Range (Hourly): $45\.93 to $51\.54

jobs.title: Project Manager – Afterschool Programs
jobs.description:
Project Manager – Afterschool Programs

**CAM Educational Services (CAM Edu)**

**Pay:** $28\.00–$30\.00 per hour  
**Job Type:** Part\-Time  
**Work Location:** Millbrae, South San Francisco (SSF), and San Mateo, CA  
**Work Setting:** In Person

About CAM Educational Services

CAM Educational Services is an innovative educational organization providing high\-quality afterschool tutoring, childcare, and enrichment programs in partnership with schools and communities throughout California.

We are looking for an experienced, organized, and dependable **Project Manager – Afterschool Programs** to support the successful operation of our programs across **Millbrae, South San Francisco, and San Mateo**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an education professional, program coordinator, site supervisor, project manager, or experienced youth\-program leader who enjoys working with children, supporting staff, and building strong relationships with schools and communities.

About the Role

The Project Manager will oversee and support the day\-to\-day operations of assigned CAM Edu afterschool programs. This position requires strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.

The Project Manager will work closely with instructors, site staff, school administrators, families, and CAM Edu leadership to ensure programs are properly staffed, organized, safe, engaging, and aligned with school and district expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily operations of assigned afterschool programs.
* Coordinate and support instructors, childcare staff, tutors, and other program team members.
* Ensure assigned programs are adequately staffed and operational.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, schedules, and classroom coverage.
* Assist with staff scheduling and make adjustments based on program needs.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor program operations and quality.
* Communicate regularly with school administrators and CAM Edu leadership.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with school and district partners.
* Support staff onboarding, training, coaching, and professional development.
* Monitor classroom quality, student engagement, and classroom management.
* Ensure staff follow CAM Edu policies, procedures, and safety expectations.
* Address staff, student, parent, and school concerns professionally and promptly.
* Assist with incident reporting, attendance tracking, and required documentation.
* Monitor program supplies, classroom materials, equipment, and other resources.
* Ensure classrooms are safe, clean, organized, and prepared for daily programming.
* Support implementation of curriculum, enrichment activities, and program schedules.
* Track staffing needs, operational concerns, and follow\-up items.
* Provide regular updates and reports to CAM Edu management.
* Identify opportunities to improve program quality, efficiency, and staff performance.
* Assist with launching and supporting new school programs and initiatives.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned by management.

Leadership \& Staff Support

The Project Manager will serve as a key resource for program staff and will be expected to:

* Provide clear direction and expectations to staff.
* Support instructors with classroom\-management and student\-related concerns.
* Monitor employee attendance, performance, and professionalism.
* Identify staffing gaps and communicate coverage needs promptly.
* Provide coaching and constructive feedback.
* Help maintain a positive, respectful, and collaborative work environment.
* Escalate employee concerns to CAM Edu leadership when appropriate.

School \& Community Relations

* Maintain professional communication with school administrators, teachers, and district representatives.
* Respond to school requests and follow up on operational concerns.
* Represent CAM Edu professionally at assigned school sites.
* Build positive relationships with school staff, families, and community partners.
* Help ensure programs meet school and district expectations.
* Support CAM Edu's long\-term partnerships with schools and communities.

Qualifications

* Experience in education, afterschool programs, childcare, youth development, program coordination, or project management preferred.
* Previous leadership, supervisory, or program\-management experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting or managing teams of employees.
* Experience working with school\-age children and youth programs.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with CAM Edu leadership.
* Professional, dependable, flexible, and solution\-oriented attitude.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced educational environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, Management, Child Development, or a related field preferred but not required with relevant experience.

Work Expectations

* Part\-time position.
* Must be available to work in person at assigned school sites.
* Must be willing to support programs in **Millbrae, South San Francisco, and San Mateo**.
* Must be flexible with scheduling based on school and program needs.
* Must be available to travel between assigned sites when needed.
* Reliable transportation is strongly preferred.
* Must be responsive to time\-sensitive staffing and operational matters.
* Must be comfortable working with children, school personnel, families, and employees.
* Must maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling student, employee, and school information.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is:

* Organized, dependable, and proactive.
* A strong and professional communicator.
* Comfortable leading and supporting staff.

jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Position Overview**

**This role is based in Phoenix, AZ or Santa Clara, CA in alignment with our flexible work policy. (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible).**


Vantage is seeking an ambitious, self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and resourceful Strategic Account Manager to support the Customer Experience (CE) team. You will also serve as a senior liaison across various departments, acting as a key facilitator within the CE team to support customer requests and drive customer satisfaction. The daily responsibilities of this role include overseeing complex customer requests and documentation, leading strategic coordination of meetings, and managing high\-visibility activities such as MBR/QBR preparation, construction communications, and customer audits. A successful candidate will work closely with Technical Account Managers (TAMs), identifying and executing on opportunities for improvement while serving as a senior bridge between teams. jobs.title: Near Patient Private Sector Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**
----------------------------------------------



At International SOS, we are in the business of protecting and saving lives. For 40 years, we have delivered customised security risk management, health, and wellbeing solutions to organisations worldwide. With a presence in 90 countries and a team of nearly 13,000 experts, we provide 24/7 support to help organisations fulfil their Duty of Care responsibilities.


Now, we’re looking for talented individuals to join our team and make a difference.


The Near Patient Private Sector Care Coordinator is critical in processing and for the flow of medical information between Private Sector Care Providers and Military Medical Providers within their respective AOR. Additionally, they are expected to provide the high\-quality healthcare assistance and, personalized customer service each time they contact TRICARE Overseas Program stakeholders and maintain high standards of professionalism, compassion and, attention to case management detail.


They are a Military Treatment Facility (MTF) embedded asset that handles caseloads for host nation medical care.

* Serve as a key administrative support role embedded within Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs) and/or Private Sector healthcare providers.
* Facilitate coordination between medical teams and private sector care providers to ensure efficient case management.
* Support clinical operations by managing medical caseloads for beneficiaries receiving private sector care.
* Arrange, Cancel and Reschedule private sector care appointments as requested.
* Additionally, play a critical role in sourcing Medical Records including when required for clinical quality case reviews.
* Serve as an escalation point for military medical provider concerns or updates regarding host nation care.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Personal Qualities:*

* Handle cases and phone calls efficiently and per the TRICARE Overseas Program Standard Operations Procedures.
* Works effectively at pace and under pressure.
* Assist with the induction of new Coordinators by mentoring them during their training program.
* Able to provide empathetic, quality service to our customers.
* Understands and thrives within a team to deliver effective completion of daily tasks.
* Maintains a professional behaviour

*Facilitation of Care Coordination:*

* Ensure timely daily case openings to enable the medical team to address patient needs within established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Coordinate the allocation of cases to the appropriate region or department based on clinical requirements.
* Communicate evolving demands and caseload changes to relevant stakeholders to support operational responsiveness.
* Answer all incoming calls using the prescribed protocols transferring all medical calls to the Regional Medical Director and/or TOP Latin America Canada Coordinating Nurse on duty.
* Ensure providers are selected from the clinical quality optimized TOP Provider Network.
* Contact the selected provider and arrange the most suitable appointment date and time.
* Communicate/Coordinate and verify with the military providers and or directly with beneficiaries the appointment details
* Maintain open communication lines with Other HNCCs, Near Patient Team Members, Regional Call Centers, Provider Network Managers, Client Relationship Leads, Clients and other International SOS Assistance Centre staff when dealing with case management.
* Coordinate the retrieval of medical records with Private Sector Care Providers and process the medical records in accordance with Medical Records Collection SOPs
* Follow\-up with beneficiaries, military providers and private sector care providers by phone or email whenever necessary to ensure optimal information flow to beneficiaries and providers.
* Use the CRM Software Management application for all case management, in/out\-bound tasks and actions per operating procedures.
* Maintain the transmission document in a clear, accurate and concise format with the correct plan of action for handovers ensuring the Medical Team are aware of medical records and actions.

*Quality Assurance*  

* Comply within established service recovery protocol and complete the online CFS form to create feedback records for quality tracking.
* Report any cases which may result in a possible complaint to the TLAC Operations Manager\[VF2\.1]
* Escalate any complaints received to the TLAC Operations Manager\[VF3\.1] and are entered into RiskMan™
* In\-country support to the clinical quality assurance team with medical record collections for PQI investigations.
* Maintains confidentiality of all beneficiary information in accordance with HIPAA and GDPR. carrying out all policies and procedures pertaining to the duties of a TRICARE Customer Service Executive.
* Attends and participates in International SOS staff meetings and educational offerings and completes other tasks as directed.

**Required Skills and Knowledge**  

* Customer service experience
* Team player
* Identifies and acts on potential problems and /or difficulties
* Demonstrates effective problem\-solving skills and lateral thinking
* Takes initiative, demonstrates responsibility
* Ability to work under pressure, multi\-task and prioritize in a timely and effective manner
* Ability to provide clear and concise written updates in English
* Ability to write, speak and listen effectively in English and Spanish
 **Desired Work Experience**  

* Customer Service within a matrix organisation
* Travel or Study Abroad Experience (Studies, Personal, Volunteer) preferred
* Previous Professional Work Experience after or during College: Financial, Translation, Education, Non\-Governmental Organisations
* Previous administrative experience in a healthcare setting (doctor’s office, hospital, lab, etc\[GK4\.1].).
* Hospitality industry experience desired

* Commensurate Security Clearance based on DoD requirements

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience creating go\-to\-market strategies.
* Experience working with product marketing teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience working with various digital marketing channels in an e\-commerce, gaming, or digital content business.
* Experience working with a product/engineering team to launch new products, features or consumer programs for global companies.
* Previous business planning or chief of staff responsibilities (e.g., Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), budget, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), etc.).
* Strong understanding of program management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


Google Play is at the heart of the Android ecosystem, providing the apps, games, and digital content that bring Android devices to life. The Play store serves more than 2\.5B users across over 190 countries, and is a critical driver of Google’s overall business growth. Googlers working on the Play Go\-To\-Market (GTM) teams own content strategy and publishing within the Play Store across all regions and verticals (Apps, Games, and more).


As a Program Manager, you will work on a large portfolio of innovative products and programs such as new and engaging mechanics that can enhance user engagement while strengthening proven capabilities to improve scalability and robustness.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with all of the teams involved with Go\-To\-Market programs and tooling solutions including product marketing, product, engineering, finance, partnerships, operations, and more to create and execute GTM plans, manage launches, and scale the business.


Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Be responsible for managing and delivering on a large portfolio of projects in various strategic areas for Play including (but not limited to) games and apps GTM, loyalty programs and new Play transformation or expansion programs.
* Be responsible for the cross\-functional coordination of GTM workstreams such as CRM strategy, branding, digital channel activation and amplification plans, Marketing / PR plan, tooling, partnerships, etc.
* Develop strong partnerships with cross\-functional stakeholders and partners to influence across boundaries leveraging solid thought leadership.
* Identify and address opportunities to scale tooling/processes and optimize for efficiency across the organization. Drive recommendations through to implementation and results.
* Lead effective meetings and communications to drive focused decision\-making across global audiences ranging from steering committees to working groups.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Lab Operations Manager, Systems Integration | Consumer Devices
jobs.description:
Software \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. Guided by OpenAI’s mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, our team combines world\-class researchers, engineers, designers, and operators who care deeply about creating useful, intuitive, and responsible technology. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside exceptional people on ambitious, zero\-to\-one challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI. This is a chance to help define an entirely new category of products—and shape how people experience AI in the future.


The **Systems Integration team** is critical in this mission, turning complex hardware\-software development into reliable product signals. Lab Operations is the physical backbone of that work: we build and maintain the device fleets, test environments, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop labs that let teams test repeatably, understand failures, and ship with confidence.


**About the Role**


As a **Lab Operations Manager, Systems Integration**, you will own the day\-to\-day operation of a large\-scale consumer device test lab. This is a hands\-on operations leadership role: you’ll keep device fleets, test rigs, lab infrastructure, inventory, provisioning, maintenance, and logistics running smoothly so engineers and QA technicians have reliable environments for validation and release testing.


We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, technically hands\-on, comfortable with consumer electronics and lab equipment, and experienced operating complex physical test environments at scale. Because this is a new category of devices, you’ll have the opportunity to build the lab operating model early—shaping the systems, standards, and workflows that support products from prototype through launch.


**In this role, you will:**


* **Own device fleet and inventory:** Manage configuration, deployment, tracking, lifecycle, and accurate asset records for a large fleet of consumer devices and test equipment; coordinate receiving, storage, checkout, shipping, transfers, spares, and secure disposal**.**
* **Operate and maintain the lab:** Keep racks, benches, test rigs, cabling, power, networking, peripherals, and shared equipment reliable and organized; diagnose issues and coordinate repairs, replacements, and preventive maintenance**.**
* **Prepare devices for testing:** Flash, provision, reset, configure, label, and assign devices to test environments**.**
* **Support testing and diagnostics:** Partner with engineering and QA on large\-scale test automation setups, failure reproduction, diagnostics collection, log capture, and environment resets**.**
* **Plan lab readiness and capacity:** Track fleet health, rig availability, utilization, and upcoming test needs; identify constraints before they block testing**.**
* **Partner across teams:** Work with hardware, systems, QA, reliability, IT, and infrastructure teams to keep the lab ready for development and release activities**.**

**Minimum Qualifications**


* Proven track\-record of operating or supporting a hardware, electronics, reliability, manufacturing, or QA test lab.
* Hands\-on experience managing fleets of consumer electronics, embedded devices, prototypes, or connected hardware.
* Comfortable setting up, configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining devices, test rigs, networking, power systems, and peripherals across USB, Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, power, and device connectivity.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**


* Have strong organizational skills and can manage competing requests while keeping inventory, asset tracking, maintenance records, lab logistics, and shared spaces documented and operational.
* Are comfortable following technical procedures for provisioning, firmware installation, resets, diagnostics collection, and test setup.
* Communicate clearly with engineersation.
* Enjoy improving the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of physical lab operations.
* Basic CAD familiarity is a plus.

**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Consumer Device Safety Operations
jobs.description:
Trust \& Safety \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**
------------------


At OpenAIs of misuse. We operate at the front line of real\-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems.


This role sits on a team focused on building operational capacity for new, ambiguous, and fast\-moving company priorities. The team defines what needs to be built, creates the operating model to support it, and works with partner teams to make the work scalable and durable over time.


**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a senior program manager to build the safety, quality, and risk operations supporting a new category of consumer devices. You will translate ambiguous product risks and evolving requirements into practical operating models, workflows, escalation paths, launch\-readiness plans, and cross\-functional decision\-making. This is a foundational role: the systems you build will shape how OpenAI launches, monitors, and improves a new category of consumer devices safely at scale.


You will help establish how potential safety incidents, product\-quality concerns, sensitive customer escalations, privacy\-sensitive issues, and other emerging device risks are identified, investigated, resolved, and incorporated into product and operational improvements. You will turn incomplete requirements into practical workflows, decision rights, launch plans, quality controls, measurement, and durable ownership.


The role centers on program building, operational judgment, and execution. We welcome candidates from product safety, quality assurance, regulatory operations, technical program management, healthcare, medical devices, aerospace, consumer technology, and other environments involving complex products or regulated risks. Direct consumer\-hardware experience is helpful but not required.


The strongest candidates learn unfamiliar technical domains quickly, ask sharp questions, and translate product, engineering, quality, regulatory, policy, legal, and user needs into operations that work in practice.


Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in\-office.


Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning material. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential.


**In This Role, You Will**
--------------------------


* Lead strategic operational builds for device\-safety and product\-quality priorities from problem statement to implemented operating model, including scope, owners, milestones, risks, success measures, and execution cadence.
* Define intake, severity criteria, decision rights, evidence requirements, escalation paths, response standards, closure criteria, and post\-incident learning for high\-risk cases.
* Translate product, engineering, quality, regulatory, legal, privacy, policy, support, and operational requirements into practical workflows, clear ownership, playbooks, and measurable operating standards.
* Build launch\-readiness plans, training, quality controls, reporting, monitoring, and early\-life response mechanisms.
* Coordinate across Product, Hardware and Software Engineering, Product Safety, Product Quality, Legal, Privacy, Product Policy, Support, Logistics, vendors, and USRO to resolve dependencies and keep critical work moving. Partner with fraud, privacy, legal, and other specialized teams when device\-related issues require their expertise.
* Use operational dataance, identify patterns, and improve workflows.
* Drive critical escalations and cross\-functional decisions to closure with clear context, accountable owners, documented decisions, and durable follow\-through.
* Create the mechanisms that make complex programs run well, including roadmaps, decision logs, risk registers, operating reviews, status updates, and executive communication.
* Identify where AI tools, automation, lightweight systems, or simpler workflows can improve speed, consistency, investigation, and quality while preserving appropriate human judgment.
* Stand up priority workflows, operate them through launch and stabilization, and transition mature capabilities into durable homes across USRO and partner teams.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**
----------------------------------------


* Have 8\+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, product operations, product safety, quality assurance, regulatory operations, incident management, healthcare operations, or another complex, high\-accountability operational field.
* Are technically and analytically fluent enough to reason about data flows, telemetry, logs, dashboards, access controls, case systems, automation, and failure modes, even if you are not writing production code.
* Have a track record of taking complex, ambiguous, and unstructured work from problem framing through product launch, operational readiness, and scaled operation.
* Can create clarity across many moving pieces without losing the few decisions, risks, and dependencies that matter most.
* Have sound judgment in high\-severity or sensitive situations and can make practicalation.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager (Site, Facility Operations)
jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own critical facility operations for one Crux site or campus — the electrical, mechanical, fire/life\-safety, and controls infrastructure that keeps high\-density, liquid\-cooled TPU clusters continuously available. You will lead the 24/7 site facility team — chief engineer, shift technicians, and O\&M contractors — and run the maintenance, procedures, drills, and change control that produce uptime, whether the building is Crux\-owned or operated by a colocation partner you hold to SLA. In the early phase you will help bring the site to life: commissioning participation, acceptance, and the transition from construction to disciplined steady\-state operations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Establish and direct the site facility operations team — chief engineer, critical facility technicians, and contractors — with a 24/7 coverage model you design, staff, and train, maintaining highly available operations for all critical and non\-critical infrastructure.
* Operate and maintain the site’s electrical systems (utility interface through switchgear, generators, UPS, and distribution), mechanical plant (chilled water, direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling loops, CDUs, heat rejection), fire/life\-safety, and BMS/EPMS controls.
* Run the site maintenance program in CMMS — preventive, predictive, and corrective — with vendor and OEM service contracts managed to scope, and zero tolerance for overdue critical PMs.
* Enforce operating discipline: SOPs/MOPs/EOPs current and rehearsed, change management on every energized system, drill program run on schedule, and monthly self\-assessments presented to fleet leadership.
* Lead site incident response for facility events end to end — detection, stabilization, escalation, root cause, corrective action — including communication when customer workloads are at risk.
* On partner sites, manage the colocation operator to contracted SLAs: audit their maintenance records, witness their critical work, and enforce remedies when performance slips.
* Support site bring\-up: participate in commissioning through Level 5/IST, define and enforce ops acceptance criteria, tune the cooling plant to design intent in the first year, and manage warranty claims.
* Own the site facility budget, utility coordination, and efficiency performance (PUE, WUE, energy cost), and run a safety\-first culture (LOTO, energized work controls, working at height) with zero\-compromise standards.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Site staffing plan and 24/7 coverage model will be approved with hiring in motion.
* Ops acceptance criteria will be agreed upon with construction/commissioning.

**After 6 months:**

* CMMS is loaded with the site asset registry and PM schedules.
* Procedures library is drafted for every critical system (or partner program audited, on a colo site).

**After 1 year:**

* First site is operating with 24/7 coverage under the full standards library.
* Preventive maintenance program is live in CMMS with zero overdue critical PMs.
* Incident and change management program running.
* Colo partner SLA and audit program in force at partner sites.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 10\+ years in critical facility or data center operations — including power generation, HVAC, or mission\-critical military/industrial environments — with 5\+ years managing technical teams and vendors operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, and controls infrastructure in a 24/7 environment.
* Comprehensive working knowledge of electrical topologies (N\+1/2N, UPS, generators, switchgear), mechanical and liquid cooling systems, fire/life\-safety, and building automation — plus the safety programs (LOTO, hazardous energy control) that govern work on them.
* Site bring\-up or major expansion experience: commissioning participation, acceptance testing, and the construction\-to\-operations handoff on a mission\-critical facility.

**Attributes**

* *Owner of the building.* When the plant alarms at 2am it is yours until the site is stable and the root cause is written down. You are comfortable being the most senior Crux person on site and making the call under pressure.
* *Discipline without bureaucracy.* You run tight MOPs, drills, and change control because they prevent outages, and you kill process that does not — and you can tell the difference.

**Mindset**

* *High tolerance for ambiguity.* The site will energize before every procedure exists. You write the SOP, run it, fix it, and hand it to the next site rather than waiting for a standard to arrive.
* *AI\-agentic first.* Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* 7\+ years in Tier III/IV or hyperscale data center environments (Meta, Google, AWS, Microsoft, or a major colo operator).
* Direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling plant operations experience (CDUs, water chemistry, loop commissioning and tuning).
* Trade certifications (Electrical, HVAC, Controls), stationary engineer license, or military/nuclear power backgro

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Intuit's CTREC organization (Cybersecurity, Trust \& Safety, Risk, Enterprise Systems and Compliance) protects the company and powers the technology experiences of our global workforce. We're looking for a Senior Change Manager to own organizational change management (OCM) delivery and adoption strategy for CTREC's most critical programs — the changes that touch every Intuit employee, from security protocols to enterprise systems to employee\-experience technology.  

This is a hands\-on leadership role, not an advisory one. You will craft the change strategy for each program and personally execute every piece of it — communications across channels, enablement content, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement. There is no separate design or communications team behind you, and no runway to learn the discipline on the job. Skilled, self\-directed OCM leadership is essential to adoption success from day one.

You'll operate as part of the Change COE — the team that designs the human layer around technology change so employees don't just get access to something new; they understand it, want it, and can use it well. The COE matches its response to the size and risk of each change: it Drives the highest\-impact changes end to end, Supports moderate ones by contributing strategy while the owning team executes, and Consults as the fast expert check on lower\-risk changes. You'll flex across all three modes and partner with the OCM lead to define the engagement model and tiered level of support for each initiative. **Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end OCM delivery and adoption strategy for critical CTREC programs — from impact assessment through launch, adoption, and reinforcement.
* Build change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end yourself: audience and impact analysis, adoption plans, success metrics, and risk mitigation — with no reliance on separate design or communications resources.
* Develop and deliver communications for multiple channels (email, Slack, intranet, in\-tool messaging, executive briefings), right\-sized to audience and moment.
* Create enablement content — guides, FAQs, training assets, self\-service resources — that helps a distributed global workforce understand, embrace, and adopt change.
* Drive stakeholder engagement across all levels, from frontline employees to senior leadership, building the coalitions each change needs to land.
* Partner closely with Development, the Product lead, and the Technical Program Manager as an embedded member of the program team, and align strategy with the OCM lead.
* Flex across the Change COE's engagement tiers — Drive, Support, or Consult — matching depth of involvement to the size and risk of each change, and partner with the OCM lead to define engagement models and tiered levels of support across the portfolio.
* Invent creative, low\-friction adoption solutions — resourceful ways to reach and activate distributed audiences and build trust in automation that acts on a user's behalf.
* Develop and implement change management tools and processes that accelerate change activities, ensure a consistent change experience, and standardize communication approaches across programs.
* Monitor employee feedback channels to address questions and gauge sentiment on Security change initiatives, feeding insights back into program decisions.
* Measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate — closing the loop between user sentiment and program decisions.

 **Qualifications**

jobs.description:
### **Position**

**ASSOCIATE PROGRAM MANAGER, PACKAGING**

**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.


Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market\-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct\-to\-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:


* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever\- constant, and agility is our strength.
Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.  
* 

The salary range for this position is $81,900 \- $94,300 per year. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in\-office, with Monday and Friday remote.


Kendo Total Rewards offerings also include an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental and vision insurance, flex paid time off program, parental leave, employee discount/perks, a retirement plan with employer contributions, Summer Fridays, opportunity to work from anywhere for two weeks during the calendar year and December wellness/shutdown week for applicable positions.


The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.  



**SUMMARY**

Independent self\-starter responsible for managing the creative development of packaging artwork for two Kendo brands. Responsible for ensuring on\-time delivery of packaging artwork \& deliverables throughout the creative process, from concept development through final execution.


### **Job responsibilities**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Manages packaging creation and delivery process (70%):**

* Assist in bi\-weekly status meeting, keep team leads informed and discuss status for each project while establishing clear next steps resolving blocks that impede progress
* Upload and monitor individual project timelines through Asana
* Actively monitor schedules and follow\-up on internal copy/layout/mechanical due dates to ensure teams meet deadlines throughout lifespan of each artwork piece
* Follow up with team leads for missing packaging information (e.g., dielines, ingredient lists, copy, translations, UPCs, fill weight, etc.). Add dielines, ingredient lists, fill weights, UPCs to server.
* Work directly with Regulatory \& Compliance team to track and confirm EU artwork approval
* Communicate projects to Production Artists and outline daily priorities
* Follow up on questions/approvals with internal teams
* Collaborate with Production Artist to confirm artwork releases and approvals of samples
* Actively participate in weekly Product Development and Operation meetings
* Track comp requests for photo shoots, Market Week, etc.

**Manage artwork routing process (30%):**

* Upload and route artwork in ProofHQ: ensure all questions are resolved and Production Artists are clear on changes
* Review/Check\-in artwork from Production Artists
### **Profile**

**REQUIREMENTS**

* BA degree or equivalent experience preferred
* 2\+ years of project management experience in retail or agency
* Proficient knowledge of computer programs: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Asana, Workfront Proof SmartSheets
* Retail or beauty experience preferred
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal
* Solid organizational skills, detail\-oriented; time management skills, ability to juggle priorities
* Strong relationship\-building skills; ability to work with a variety of people in various disciplines
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment and meet very tight deadlines
* The drive to excel and succeed; self\-motivated
* Passion for beauty and retail
***Crafting Dreams Starts With Yours***
---------------------------------------

**At LVMH, people make the difference in the art of crafting dreams.**  

Our people fuel our dynamic, entrepreneurial culture. We value collective ambitions, encouraging our talents to push boundaries and champion a curious, audacious state of mind. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in nurturing every individual with a growth mindset and development opportunities, consistently empowering them to reach their full potential. We are actively committed to positive impact through an inclusive environment that supports and gives back to our talented community.
  

Join us at LVMH, where your talent is at the heart of our collective successes.

Overview:

The Innovation with Academia (IWA) Student Prototyping Program Manager serves as a program leader within the Defense Innovation Unit's Innovation with Academia program. IWA connects Department of War (DoW) mission problems with university talent, research, and expertise to develop pathways from problem discovery through prototyping, commercialization, transition, and ultimately capability the Department can use.  

The IWA Student Prototyping program utilizes experiential learning to inspire students to experience work in the National Security Industrial Base by matching highly talented undergraduate and graduate students to deliver rapid, early\-stage prototypes, whether technical or policy centered, that help solve the mission partner’s problem.  

The Student Prototyping Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, performance, and continuous improvement of IWA’s student prototyping programs and initiatives. ### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.


Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products. We’re looking for people with proven track records of delivering complex, integrated, cross\-functional products with high standards of quality. Digital program managers are engaged in all aspects of the product lifecycle from requirements analysis and architectural design to software engineering development, QA, deployment, and market rollout. Our program managers align hardware and software engineering, clinical and regulatory schedules, and ensure that the right products are created at the right time, with low drama.


At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task\-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. This means that while strong program management fundamentals are a must, the role requires an understanding of product development and manufacturing, and, most importantly, managing through influence.


We look for candidates who know what success looks like and feel a personal stake in the services they support and the people they manage. People who understand how medical technology products are developed. People with a deep well of positive energy and unbounded enthusiasm. We look for people who hold themselves and their program teams to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. People with unshakeable integrity and deep wisdom \& judgment. People who need to know why. People who are comfortable in ambiguity and excel at bringing order to it. People who strive to simplify and to clarify. People who are as comfortable presenting to execs as they are with their nose buried in a burndown chart.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**


* Effectively manage cross\-functional development programs across Intuitive’s different Business units and shared services, overseeing critical projects, and delivering against commitments.
* Help teams prioritize tasks to focus on the critical activities that drive progress and avoid being sidetracked by less important issues.
* Collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to ensure the right people are updated with the right information at the right time on status and ensure that cross\-product dependencies are understood, planned for, and crisply executed
* Perform risk analysis, develop contingency plans, and gather data from functions to proactively raise prioritization and scheduling tradeoff decisions
* Drive required discipline and rigor in requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through good development practices and effective use of phase gates.
* Work across the organization and external partners as needed to align functional support and input for the project
* Contribute to and help lead improvement Intuitive project management processes and ongoing improvements to the way we ship new products and capabilities.
* Function as a primary point\-of\-contact for stakeholders across the org.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Demonstrated history of leadership in project, program, and portfolio management of software delivery programs, at scale.
* Demonstrated excellence in program management capabilities across product lifecycle, from ideation through commercialization.
* Strong grasp of software product development engineering principles, manufacturing, servicing, and quality control.
* Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations
* Proven ability to think strategically, plan and align product development with business goals and market needs.
* Naturally accountable and responsible; self\-starter, self\-motivated, self\-directed, self\-sufficient.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills, written and verbal, to all levels of an organization.
* Experience with development and commercialization of medical technology.
* Ability to recognize project challenges and drive creative and simple solutions with a customer\-focused approach
* Proven ability to influence at various levels and drive conflict resolution with low drama

**Required Education and Training**


* At least 8 years of program \& project management experience with a bachelor’s degree and 6 years with a Master’s degree. This must include hands\-on experience with development and commercialization of highly technical medical devices.
* Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations preferred.
* Certification in project management (PMP, CSM) desired

**Duties:**


As a Factory Program Manager for the Client's Proto Hardware team, you will serve as our primary onsite representative at Foxconn San Jose. You will coordinate daily factory activities, support new product introduction builds and engineering experiments, and drive Foxconn follow\-through on shared priorities and open issues.


You will bring structure and visibility to the work happening at the site. You will maintain the integrated schedule and issue list, coordinate onsite support, communicate weekly priorities, and escalate risks before they affect engineering or build schedules. This is a 6\-month contract position that requires working onsite at Foxconn San Jose five days per week.

**You Will:**

* Own the day\-to\-day coordination of activities at Foxconn San Jose, including new product introduction (NPI) builds, design of experiments (DOEs), testing, failure analysis, material deliveries, and facility work.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the Client's Hardware Team and the Foxconn San Jose team.

* Support build readiness by coordinating materials, equipment, documentation, staffing, and other requirements.
* Ensure results from experiments, testing, and failure analysis are documented and shared with the appropriate engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve factory processes, site organization, and collaboration between the Client and Foxconn.
* Coordinate site infrastructure and workspace needs in partnership with Engineering, Operations, and IT.

 **Skills:**

* 5\+ years of experience in hardware program management, factory operations, manufacturing operations, or NPI.
* Experience working onsite with a contract manufacturer, preferably in electronics or printed circuit board assembly manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of hardware development and manufacturing processes, including surface\-mount technology, assembly, testing, and production ramp.
* Experience managing multiple workstreams with competing priorities, shared resources, and tight schedules.
* Strong issue management skills and a consistent track record of driving actions to closure.
* The ability to understand technical discussions, identify dependencies, and communicate effectively with engineering and manufacturing teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex activities for technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive approach and the ability to bring structure to an environment where processes and priorities may change quickly.

* Experience supporting engineering DOEs, hardware validation, or failure analysis.

* Experience managing factory lab spaces, facility upgrades, or production floor layouts.
* Experience with material readiness, inventory coordination, and supply chain activities.
* Previous experience working with Foxconn or another large electronics manufacturing services provider.
* A technical degree or equivalent practical experience.

* Coordinate end\-to\-end execution of hardware tester system programs consisting of multiple PCBAs, mechanical parts, cables, connectors, power components, and system accessories.

* Manage board\-level and system\-level BOM readiness, material availability, and part number tracking.
* Drive hardware build planning and execution across multiple boards and subsystems simultaneously.
* Partner with Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Validation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and external suppliers to resolve issues and maintain schedules.
* Track engineering changes, material shortages, build risks, and dependency blockers.
* Monitor build status, integration readiness, bring\-up activities, validation progress, and issue closure.
* Maintain program dashboards, action item trackers, risk registers, and executive status reporting.
* Coordinate supplier and manufacturing partner activities to ensure material and build readiness.
* Facilitate regular cross\-functional meetings and drive accountability for deliverables and action items.

* Ability to interpret and track hardware assemblies, PCBAs, mechanical components, cables, and subsystem dependencies.
* Proficiency with project management tools, spreadsheets, and issue tracking systems.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting tester, fixture, validation, manufacturing, or datacenter hardware programs.
* Familiarity with hardware part numbering and BOM structures (e.g., board assemblies, system assemblies, manufacturing BOMs, and engineering BOMs).
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and hardware suppliers.
* Understanding of NPI, prototype, EVT/DVT/PVT, or manufacturing build processes.
* Experience coordinating material readiness, build execution, and validation activities in a fast\-paced hardware environment.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Lead a program organization to deliver measurable reliability and operational excellence outcomes across Payments Production Management.

**Job Description**


Embark on a transformative journey in technology risk and operational excellence at an iconic financial firm. You will help shape how critical services are delivered, improving reliability, transparency, and outcomes as we modernize how we run production. You will partner with engineering and operations leaders to turn complex initiatives into well\-governed programs that drive continuous improvement.


As a Technology Support Lead at JPMorganChase within Payments Production Management team, you will build the structures and operating rhythms that translate a broad portfolio of initiatives into a cohesive transformation roadmap. You will create clarity across diverse stakeholders, establish governance tied to outcomes, and drive disciplined execution that accelerates the evolution of Production Management into a mature Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization.

**Job responsibilities**

* Establish and lead a centralized program function to structure initiatives into clearly defined programs with scope, ownership, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics
* Recruit, develop, and mentor a high\-performing team of program leaders and managers to deliver programs end\-to\-end across the transformation portfolio
* Define scalable roles, standards, and ways of working across Payments Production Management
* Partner with Production Management and engineering leadership to shape a multi\-quarter transformation roadmap aligned to reliability maturity goals and business priorities
* Implement portfolio\-level governance, including intake, prioritization, sequencing, benefits tracking, and escalation to increase transparency and delivery confidence
* Consolidate fragmented efforts into coherent programs spanning reliability engineering practices, incident management maturity, observability, automation, toil reduction, capacity and performance, and release resilience
* Orchestrate cross\-functional execution across engineering, infrastructure, application teams, risk and control partners, product partners, and operations to remove blockers and accelerate delivery
* Track and improve reliability outcomes using agreed performance indicators such as availability, latency, incident frequency and severity, mean time to recovery, change failure rate, toil levels, and automation coverage
* Leads team adoption of enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to improve incident triage speed and consistency (e.g., synthesizing operational signals into prioritized actions), with human\-in\-the\-loop validation and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
* Produce executive\-ready reporting and communications that connect work to outcomes, risks, decisions, and sustained adoption
* Applies reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices across incident/problem/change routines to identify recurring interruption patterns and validate remediation actions aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise troubleshooting, resolving, and maintaining information technology services
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale a program management organization, including team formation, operating model design, governance, and execution discipline
* Proven program and portfolio leadership with strong delivery rigor, prioritization, and benefits tracking
* Strong systems\-thinking mindset and ability to drive continuous improvement through operational metrics and learning loops
* Strong understanding of IT service management and operational excellence, including incident management, problem management, observability, automation, toil reduction, reliability metrics, and service ownership
* Proven ability to create clarity out of ambiguity by structuring loosely defined initiatives into outcome\-oriented programs with measurable results
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills across senior leaders and technical teams in a matrixed environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive storytelling and concise status and risk reporting
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support production operations workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted incident recommendations before action, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to operational, security, and auditability expectations.
* Bachelor's degree required

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale payments or regulated financial services environments
* Familiarity with operational metrics frameworks such as service level indicators, service level objectives, and error budgets
* Experience partnering with risk, compliance, and control stakeholders to implement change in highly governed environments
* Experience driving agile\-at\-scale delivery and or Lean continuous improvement practices




This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorgan Chase's review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management

jobs.description:
**ASSOCIATE PROGRAM MANAGER, PACKAGING**

**ABOUT KENDO**


Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world's largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.



Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market\-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct\-to\-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:


* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone's voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It's our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever\- constant, and agility is our strength.
* Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.


The salary range for this position is $81,900 \- $94,300 per year. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in\-office, with Monday and Friday remote.



Kendo Total Rewards offerings also include an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental and vision insurance, flex paid time off program, parental leave, employee discount/perks, a retirement plan with employer contributions, Summer Fridays, opportunity to work from anywhere for two weeks during the calendar year and December wellness/shutdown week for applicable positions.





The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.





**SUMMARY**



Independent self\-starter responsible for managing the creative development of packaging artwork for two Kendo brands. Responsible for ensuring on\-time delivery of packaging artwork \& deliverables throughout the creative process, from concept development through final execution.





**RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Manages packaging creation and delivery process (70%):**


* Assist in bi\-weekly status meeting, keep team leads informed and discuss status for each project while establishing clear next steps resolving blocks that impede progress
* Upload and monitor individual project timelines through Asana
* Actively monitor schedules and follow\-up on internal copy/layout/mechanical due dates to ensure teams meet deadlines throughout lifespan of each artwork piece
* Follow up with team leads for missing packaging information (e.g., dielines, ingredient lists, copy, translations, UPCs, fill weight, etc.). Add dielines, ingredient lists, fill weights, UPCs to server.
* Work directly with Regulatory \& Compliance team to track and confirm EU artwork approval
* Communicate projects to Production Artists and outline daily priorities
* Follow up on questions/approvals with internal teams
* Collaborate with Production Artist to confirm artwork releases and approvals of samples
* Actively participate in weekly Product Development and Operation meetings
* Track comp requests for photo shoots, Market Week, etc.


**Manage artwork routing process (30%):**


* Upload and route artwork in ProofHQ: ensure all questions are resolved and Production Artists are clear on changes
* Review/Check\-in artwork from Production Artists


**REQUIREMENTS**


* BA degree or equivalent experience preferred
* 2\+ years of project management experience in retail or agency
* Proficient knowledge of computer programs: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Asana, Workfront Proof SmartSheets
* Retail or beauty experience preferred
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal
* Solid organizational skills, detail\-oriented; time management skills, ability to juggle priorities
* Strong relationship\-building skills; ability to work with a variety of people in various disciplines
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment and meet very tight deadlines
* The drive to excel and succeed; self\-motivated
* Passion for beauty and retail

We are seeking a Program Manager to join Meta's Global Product Quality (GPQ) team to support payments testing across Meta's product portfolio and contribute to the broader International Testing Program (ITP). You will manage vendor delivery, contribute to testing methodology design, and work with product, engineering, and i18n teams to turn test results into actionable recommendations. The role requires someone who is comfortable working collaboratively across a shared portfolio, applying automation to improve how testing gets delivered, and operating across multiple product lines and geographies, prioritizing based on business impact and timelines.Payments are core to how people and businesses transact across the Meta family of apps, and test cards and simulated environments can only take validation so far — real coverage requires testing with real payment methods, in\-country, the way people actually pay. Your primary focus will be Meta's payments testing programs: coordinating in\-country testing with real local payment methods, and managing the sourcing and lifecycle of real payment instruments that Meta teams use to validate flows synthetic credentials cannot reach. Beyond payments, you will support the wider ITP mission of ensuring Meta's products function as intended in every market we serve, across a portfolio that spans the full range of Meta's products with a growing emphasis on the AI\-powered experiences Meta is building.This role suits someone who is comfortable operating across a shared portfolio, who treats AI as both a subject of testing and a tool for delivering testing faster, and who can manage several product lines and geographies by prioritizing work based on impact and stakeholder needs.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, International Testing Responsibilities:**

* Own the Active Payments Testing program end\-to\-end, partnering with our external testing vendor to execute in\-country payment tests using real local payment methods across priority markets
* Own the Passive / Payment Credentials program — sourcing, provisioning, and lifecycle management of real payment instruments (cards, bank accounts, SIMs, merchant accounts) for Meta teams testing payment flows that test credentials cannot cover
* Partner with Meta privacy, legal, compliance, finance, and enterprise infrastructure teams to onboard, train, prioritize, and manage testing vendors, and to ensure payment instrument sourcing and handling meets Meta requirements
* Engage and build relationships with cross\-functional payments, product, and engineering stakeholders to drive adoption and maximize market coverage of both programs
* Partner with Quality Assurance and payments engineering leads to craft functional payment testing strategies for priority markets, products, and payment methods
* Design and implement scalable frameworks for in\-country payment test coverage, prioritizing markets and payment methods by product and business impact
* Improve scalability through automation and standardization of test execution, credential provisioning, and reporting, while ensuring maximum value to Meta payment experiences
* Utilize signals from payment testing outcomes to determine actions that improve payment success rates and product quality

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of experience in program management, including experience shipping large\-scale global products
* Experience managing external vendors or outsourced delivery partners against defined quality and coverage requirements
* Track record of gaining alignment with cross\-organization stakeholders with competing priorities and goals
* Experience aggregating, analyzing, and interpreting complex data sets to inform business decisions
* Skilled in building simple and optimized workflows to support complex product launches
* Experience communicating and driving results with a variety of cross\-functional stakeholders, working across time zones and international offices
* Track record of staying focused, prioritizing, and creating structure across large, ambiguous programs, and setting goals for long\-term initiatives

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience operating programs that require handling of financially sensitive assets under compliance, privacy, or audit requirements
* Experience in corporate business management, finance, and compliance
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* A thorough understanding of product Quality Assurance processes and best practices
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services, including familiarity with local and alternative payment methods across international markets
* Knowledge of additional languages other than English, to support testing coordination with in\-country vendors and stakeholders across international markets

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
