jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of technical infrastructure program managers, software engineers, data specialists, supply chain specialists, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for planning and execution while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) designs, delivers, and operates the global data\-center fleet that powers every AWS service. Our servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling assets in more than 245 countries and territories. We tackle some of the world’s most complex supply\-chain problems so our customers can innovate without limits.  

  

In this team you will own core functions that drive planning automation and optimization for the 0\-2 year planning horizon for AWS's rapidly growing AI/ML server footprint. You will partner with cross functional teams to deeply understand requirements for servers (power, materials, manufacturing capacity, etc.) and build forward looking plans on what we can deliver and when. Due to the quickly evolving nature of this business, requirements and designs change quickly and often involve long lead time inputs. You will partner with our tech teams to build systems that automate and optimize our planning strategies to enable scaling. Success requires exceptional judgment, a builder’s mindset, and the ability to influence at all levels—from front\-line planners to VP\- and SVP\-level business owners.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the global S\&OP cycle – Drive an end\-to\-end, weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence that aligns AWS demand signals with supply, power, and capital plans.

  

* Deliver a trusted signal – Produce a single source of truth that reconciles financial plans, sales \& growth outlooks, NPI roadmaps, transition ramps, and prior POR commitments.

  

* Run executive planning forums – Frame one\-way vs. two\-way\-door decisions, articulate trade\-offs, and secure leadership alignment across AIS, EC2, S3, EBS, Finance, and Energy.

  

* Architect planning systems – Guide software teams in automating demand\-, supply\-, and scenario\-planning workflows (e.g., Connect, o9, Infor, Manhattan); own interim manual mechanisms until automation is in place.

  

* Build decision frameworks – Develop constrained\-planning models that surface risks and levers under power, permitting, or component shortages.

  

* Measure what matters – Define KPIs and dashboards that quantify forecast accuracy, inventory turns, build\-plan adherence, and capacity\-delivery cycle time.

  

* Champion continuous improvement – Sponsor digital\-transformation sprints that simplify processes, eliminate waste, and raise planning maturity across AIS.

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.description:
Description:
**Title:** Program Manager  

**Organization:** Boys and Girls Clubs of San Leandro  

**Location:** School\-based Site  

**Department:** Programming

**Reports to:** Area Director

**Direct Reports:** Site Operations \& Safety Coordinator, KinderCare Coordinators, \& Youth Development Professionals  

**Exempt Status:** Exempt

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

**Compensation:** $70,000 \- $84,000

**Position Overview:**


The Program Manager leads high\-quality after\-school programming that empowers youth, supports families, and aligns with A.S.E.S. and ELOP standards. This role oversees program operations, staff supervision, and partnerships with schools and community organizations to create a safe, engaging, and outcome\-driven environment.


Responsible for staff development, program evaluation, and resource management, the Program Manager ensures that youth receive enriching experiences that prepare them for success. By fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and strong community engagement, this role plays a key part in advancing BGCSL’s mission to inspire and empower all young people to reach their full potential.

**Our Values in Action:**

**Transformative Leadership:** We aspire to transform possibilities into probabilities. By embodying emotional intelligence, vulnerability, and empathy, we foster positive change with humility, authenticity, and continuous self\-improvement.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Leading with empathy, self\-awareness, and a commitment to continuous growth, creating an environment where staff feel supported, empowered, and confident in their roles. Encouraging a culture of learning, collaboration, and adaptability while investing in staff development to cultivate future leaders. Ensuring alignment with organizational values by guiding youth enrichment programming, child supervision, and family engagement. Providing clear direction, feedback, and support to staff, reinforcing high standards for program quality and professionalism.

**Resilience:** We approach every situation with a growth mindset, demonstrating flexibility and courage, reframing challenges as opportunities. We acknowledge our current state, embrace change, and adapt as needed, maintaining a solutions\-oriented approach throughout our growth journey.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Navigating daily challenges such as staffing changes, behavior management, and program logistics with flexibility and a solutions\-focused mindset. Modeling perseverance and adaptability for both staff and students, ensuring program goals remain the priority despite obstacles. Creating a structured yet responsive environment where challenges become opportunities for learning and growth. Maintaining a focus on continuous improvement, using data, feedback, and site observations to enhance program effectiveness.

**Youth Centered Approach:** Every organizational action or maneuver is designed to directly impact and benefit the youth we serve. We value and prioritize the youth perspective, making decisions with a focus on their needs and well\-being, rather than adult convenience.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Prioritizing student well\-being and success by ensuring that curriculum, enrichment activities, and behavior support strategies are designed to meet the diverse needs of youth. Fostering a safe, structured, and engaging after\-school environment that bridges the gap between school, home, and community. Actively incorporating student voices into programming, creating a space where all young people feel valued, seen, and empowered. Building strong relationships with school staff, parents, and community partners to align site culture and resources in support of youth development.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Leadership \& Program Oversight**: Manage after\-school site programs, activities, and services to prepare youth for success while ensuring compliance with A.S.E.S./ELOP standards and maintaining a safe, outcome\-driven environment.
* **Staff Supervision \& Development**: Provide leadership to the Kinder Care Coordinator and Youth Development Professionals (YDPs), guiding child supervision, youth enrichment programming, and parent engagement while reinforcing organizational values.
* **Training \& Professional Growth**: Participate in and occasionally plan meetings, trainings, and organizational events, ensuring staff development and adherence to best practices in after\-school programming.
* **Program Evaluation \& Continuous Improvement**: Utilize CRM (MyClubHub) data, compile monthly reports, and conduct site observations to assess program effectiveness and recommend improvements in collaboration with key stakeholders.
* **Accountability \& Performance Management**: Supervise staff, ensure adherence to program goals and objectives, administer corrective action when necessary, and partner with HR and leadership to address staff or member\-related issues.
* **Budget \& Resource Management**: Oversee site operations within the approved budget, control expenditures, collaborate with school staff on safety and cleanliness, and contribute to grant writing and reporting for financial sustainability.
* **Community \& School Partnerships**: Develop and maintain relationships with school administrators, parents, and community organizations, attending faculty and principal meetings to align site culture, goals, and values.
* **Program Promotion \& Outreach**: Represent BGCSL, promote membership, coordinate program publicity, and maintain ongoing communication with external stakeholders to strengthen engagement and community impact.

**Required:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in after\-school programming, youth development, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in staff supervision, coaching, and leadership.
* Strong understanding of child safety, behavior management, and youth engagement strat

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Broccoli**  



At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.


We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.


Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.


Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.


Today:

* Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.
* We've grown to **$15M\+ ARR in under two years.**
* We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.
* We're backed by **Khosla Ventures** and **Y Combinator**.


We're still just getting started.  

  

**The Role**


Broccoli is looking for a People Operations Coordinator to serve as the right hand to our Director of People. This person will be the glue that holds our day\-to\-day people operations together — owning the details that make our employees feel taken care of, while also handling core HR administrative work. This is a great fit for someone who thrives on variety, loves being the go\-to person for questions, and wants to help build culture at a growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own employee engagement and recognition programs — planning, coordinating, and executing initiatives that build culture and celebrate our team
* Lead the new hire onboarding experience end\-to\-end: preparing workspaces before day one, greeting new hires at the door, and making sure their first days feel welcoming and organized
* Manage new hire swag inventory and prep — ensuring swag is stocked, prepped ahead of new hire start dates, and sent out in time for arrival
* Help coordinate device and equipment setup for new employees, including ordering desks, monitors, and other workstation needs
* Own new hire checklist completion — tracking progress and following up directly with new hires on outstanding onboarding items
* Handle core HR administrative tasks, including sending offer letters and maintaining accurate employee records
* Run regular HR reports and pull data as needed to support the Director of People and leadership
* Serve as a point of contact for HR questions, escalating to the Director of People as needed
* Partner directly with the Director of People on ongoing HR projects and initiatives
* Act as a champion of in\-office culture — keeping our SF office running smoothly and looking for ways to make it a great place to work
* Support general HR administrative needs as they come up — this role is a true catchall for People Ops

**What We're Looking For**

* 1\-3 years of experience in HR/People Operations
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail — able to juggle multiple projects simultaneously
* A warm, welcoming presence — someone who genuinely enjoys being the face of the office and making people feel taken care of
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Familiar with Rippling as an HRIS system, and comfortable using AI tools to build workflows and improve processes
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset — someone who spots what needs to get done and does it, rather than waiting to be asked
* Discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive employee information

*Broccoli is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe great teams are built by people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.*


Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

jobs.title: Device Safety & Risk Operations Specialist, User Safety & Risk Operations
jobs.description:
Trust \& Safety \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


At OpenAIs of misuse. We operate at the front line of real\-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems.


This role sits on a team focused on building operational capacity for new, ambiguous, and fast\-moving areas of work. The team defines what needs to be built, creates the operating model to support it, and works with partner teams to make the work scalable and durable over time.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Device Safety \& Risk Operations Specialist to build the safety operating model for a new category of consumer hardware. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for someone who can turn emerging product risks and incomplete requirements into practical workflows, controls, launch plans, and durable systems.


You will define how product\-safety incidents, critical escalations, regulated cases, and privacy\-sensitive issues should be identified, investigated, escalated, resolved, and learned from. You will also establish operational requirements for case management, data access, decision logging, quality assurance, monitoring, and cross\-functional response. You will stand up priority workflows through launch and early operations, then help transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams.


The right person combines deep operational judgment with strong technical and hardware product fluency. They can move from executive\-level risk framing to detailed workflow design, tabletop exercises, launch readiness, frontline guidance, and post\-launch improvement.


Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in\-office.


Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning material. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential.

  

  

**In This Role, You Will:**


* Build the end\-to\-end safety and risk operating model for new consumer hardware, from early requirements through launch and early\-life operations.
* Define incident taxonomies, severity levels, decision rights, escalation criteria, response pathways, and closure standards.
* Develop operational playbooks for product\-safety incidents, critical escalations, safety advisories, corrective actions, and other high\-risk events.
* Design workflows for regulated and privacy\-sensitive cases, including restricted handling, evidence requirements, auditability, and partner escalation.
* Translate safety and operational needs into requirements for tooling, case management, data access, monitoring, logging, and automation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries across Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Product Policy, Support, Product Quality, and other operational partners.
* Build launch\-readiness plans, tabletop exercises, training, quality controls, reporting, and post\-launch monitoring.
* Use operational data, customer signals, product telemetry, and case outcomes to identify patterns and improve upstream products and systems.
* Determine where AI and automation can improve triage, evidence assembly, consistency, and response while preserving appropriate human judgment.
* Stand up priority workflows, operate them through launch and early\-life stabilization, and transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You:**


* Have 8\+ years of relevant experience in device safety, product safety, consumer hardware operations, technical program management, or a related field.
* Have built a complex safety or risk program from an ambiguous starting point through launch and scaled operation.
* Understand the realities of handling high\-severity incidentsation, and time\-critical escalations.
* Can translate product, engineering, legal, privacy, and policy constraints into workflows that operational teams can execute.
* Are technically fluent and can reason through data flows, telemetry, access controls, audit logs, case systems, automation, and failure modes.
* Use data to assess workflow health, identify emerging patterns, evaluate quality, and make risk\-based decisions.
* Can establish clear accountability across teams with overlapping responsibilities and different risk tolerances.
* Know how to balance launch speed with safety controls, monitoring, rollback criteria, and longer\-term system development.
* Communicate clearly with operational, technical, legal, and executive audiences when evidence is incomplete or tradeoffs are difficult.
* Are highly practical and willing to build the workflow, not only define the strategy.
* Experience supporting consumer hardware, connected devices, or other products used in shared environments.
* Experience with product\-safety investigations, recalls, field failures, safety advisories, or hazardous\-product handling.
* Experience designing workflows involving privacy\-sensitive sensor, diagnostic, media, or household data.
* Familiarity with warranty, repair, reverse logistics, identity recovery, fraud, or ownership disputes.
* Experience building vendor training, quality\-assurance, incident\-response, or specialist\-review programs.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is foundational to Security delivering mission outcomes at OpenAI. jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


We are seeking a Senior Product Quality Manager to join our Supply Chain team in San Francisco, California. This role sits at the intersection of Oura Manufacturing, R\&D, and Supply Chain, partnering closely with design, process engineering, operations, and contract manufacturers (CMs) to drive the successful development and ramp of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs.


You will champion product quality and the user experience by ensuring every ring meets Oura’s rigorous standards for health accuracy, reliability, and jewelry\-like craftsmanship. You will establish and improve quality systems at CMs, ensuring robust data collection and analysis to support critical program decisions and long\-term supply chain improvements.


From concept through high\-volume production, you will develop and implement measurement methods, control plans, and quality processes that ensure components and assemblies are manufacturable, scalable, and consistently meet product requirements. You will serve as a key liaison between Oura and our manufacturing partners, fostering a strong culture of quality across the supply chain.


Working closely with Operations and Program Management, you will plan and execute NPI builds while continuously influencing both product and process development. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and the ability to translate quality requirements into scalable manufacturing solutions.


**This is a US Hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an in\-office requirement of three days per week, and will require significant travel to Finland and Asia.**


### **What You Will Do:**

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
***The Company***


Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high\-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

***The Opportunity***


We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Supply Chain Program Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.


You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

***Key Responsibilities***


Strategic Sourcing \& Category Management

* Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi\-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub\-components.
* Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
* Dual\-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain.


Supplier Relationship Management

* Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics.
* Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long\-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules.
* Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.


Cross\-Functional Leadership

* New Product Introduction: Partner with R\&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability.
* Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
* Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross\-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime.
* Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end\-to\-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks.

  

**Requirements** **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries.
* Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards).
* Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should\-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena).
* Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high\-tech industries.
* Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long\-term contracts in volatile markets.
* Experience developing and executing successful, long\-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components.
* Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning.
* Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949\.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Other Requirements**

* This is a full\-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%).

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)

* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food \& Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible

* Base Salary: $140,000 \- $160,000

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews.


Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

  

The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity.

  

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.


The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.


We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200\+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.


You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow\-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.


This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200\+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal
* Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower\-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self\-service before reaching for a calendar invite
* Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome
* Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto\-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach
* Build and run one\-to\-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in\-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans
* Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow\-up
* Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).
* Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention
* Translate portfolio\-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high\-volume portfolio
* Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role
* Technically fluent and self\-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI
* Hands\-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Series A/B/C or fast\-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to ambiguity

**Nice to have**

* Experience defining or re\-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment
* Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps
* Familiarity with research operations or market research


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

Delta, founded in 1971, is a global leader in switching power supplies and thermal management products with a thriving portfolio of smart energy\-saving systems and solutions in the fields of industrial automation, building automation, telecom power, data center infrastructure, EV charging, renewable energy, energy storage and display, to nurture the development of smart manufacturing and sustainable cities. As a world\-class corporate citizen guided by its mission statement, “To provide innovative, clean and energy\-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow,” Delta leverages its core competence in high\-efficiency power electronics and its ESG\-embedded business model to address key environmental issues, such as climate change. Delta serves customers through its sales offices, R\&D centers and manufacturing facilities spread over close to 200 locations across five continents. Delta has 158 sales offices, 72 R\&D centers and 48 manufacturing facilities worldwide.  

Throughout its history, Delta has received various global awards and recognition for its business achievements, innovative technologies, and dedication to ESG. Since 2011, Delta has been listed on the DJSI World Index of Dow Jones Sustainability™ Indices for 11 consecutive years. In 2021, Delta was also recognized by CDP with leadership level ratings for its substantial contribution to climate change and water security issues and named Supplier Engagement Leader for its continuous development of a sustainable value chain.
Key Responsibilities:

Delta Electronics is seeking an experienced Senior Account Manager to lead strategic customer relationships and drive revenue growth within the Hyperscale, AI, Cloud, and Colocation Data Center markets. This senior\-level sales position is responsible for developing and executing account strategies for some of the industry's largest customers while promoting Delta's comprehensive portfolio of Data Center Power and Thermal Infrastructure Solutions.
The Senior Account Manager will work closely with executive leadership, engineering, product management, field application engineering, and operations to deliver integrated solutions that address customers' evolving power and cooling requirements. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to customers while positioning Delta as a strategic technology partner for next\-generation AI and high\-density data center deployments.  

* Develop and execute strategic account plans for major Hyperscale, AI, Cloud Service Provider, and Colocation customers.
* Own the complete customer relationship, serving as the executive\-level point of contact across engineering, procurement, operations, facilities, and executive leadership.
* Drive revenue growth by identifying, developing, and closing opportunities across Delta's Data Center Power and Thermal Solutions portfolio.
* Promote integrated infrastructure solutions including UPS systems, Power Distribution Units (PDUs), Busway, Liquid Cooling, Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), In\-Row Cooling, Rear Door Heat Exchangers, Precision Cooling, and related infrastructure technologies.
* Build long\-term executive relationships that position Delta as a preferred strategic supplier.
* Lead complex, solution\-based sales opportunities from early engagement through commercial negotiations, contract award, implementation, and long\-term account development.

\*\*\* Remote position


Advanced Infusion Care, a division of AIS Healthcare, is the leading provider of Home Infusion Therapy. With our diverse culture, and our values around Innovation, Stewardship, and Unity, we are committed to Advancing Quality and Improving Lives. We are dedicated to doing more for our patients by providing quality products and services that enhance the entire care experience.



Advanced Infusion Care is looking for an experienced and motivated Intake Coordinator to join our dynamic team! The Intake Coordinator role is a full\-time position responsible for providing patient access to the medication and therapies needed by contacting insurance companies and verifying the patient’s health insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage/non\-coverage information and initiation/extension of authorizations.



The perfect candidate should have outstanding communication and time management skills, extreme attention to detail and accuracy, have in\-depth knowledge of insurance benefit verification, and work in compliance with Federal and State rules and regulations.



AIS Healthcare offers great benefits, including health, vision and dental insurance, long term disability insurance, life insurance, a vacation package, 401K plan with a generous employer match, remote work from home opportunity, growth, and more!


**REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**



A high school diploma or general education degree (GED) equivalent is required; minimum 2 years’ experience in customer service, medical billing and coding, benefits verification, healthcare, or similar vocations.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Enter all required demographic, physician, insurance, authorization, and other information into a profile for all new patients.


* Review all incoming faxed prescription orders and attach to new or existing patient profile.


* Contact patient or physician to fill in any missing information.


* Conduct comprehensive benefit investigation for new patient referrals. Evaluate pharmacy benefit plans and medical benefit plans.


* Obtain clinical, lab, and medical testing documentation from physicians’ offices for submission of prior authorization.


* Perform timely follow up on authorizations through the process until approved.


* Communicate with patients, physicians, and other departments on benefits and the status of authorization requests.


* Communicate denials to physicians’ offices and provide follow up details on the peer to peer or appeal options.


* Regularly communicate the status of the intake process to other departments, including Nursing, Pharmacy and Sales.


* Notify patients/families/referral sources regarding coverage and payment responsibilities as necessary.


* Provide explanation and paperwork for Care Support Program to patients who express financial hardship. Utilize manufacturer co\-pay cards as appropriate.


* Document in the patient’s clinical record progress notes, all requests and conversations for the purposes of seamless coordination of care.


* Identify in\-network or mandated pharmacy providers if unable to service a patient due to insurance constraints. Communicate related information to the patient and the physician offices and triage referral as directed.


* Provide leadership, oversight, and technical guidance to associates, and assist to resolve difficult cases. Train new associates.


* Suggest and develop documentation to standardized workflow process changes and submit for approval. Assist to document authorized process changes to Job Aids.


* Participate in any variety of meetings and work groups to integrate activities, communicate issues, obtain approvals, resolve problems and maintain specified level of knowledge pertaining to new developments, requirements, and policies.


* Train new and existing associates in the use of pharmacy software system, supplemental applications, customer service techniques, job responsibilities, and departmental workflow.


* Identify deviations from training and/or processes during normal work activity.


* Serve as the SME for new applications, software upgrades, work queues, accuracy and other related processes.


* Promote training participation and coach associates in following new and existing workflow processes. Deliver messages that promote change.


* Comply with and adheres to all regulatory compliance areas, policies and procedures and company “best practices”.


* Responsible for adhering to the quality, production, and turnaround standards associated with the department and/or assigned program.


* Other duties as assigned


**PREFERRED EXPEREINCE – Home Infusion Coordination**


**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:**


* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with patients, physicians, and coworkers.


* Active listening, speaking, understanding, and writing English.


* Ability to make decisions, solve problems, and work independently with minimal supervision.


* Proven knowledge and complete utilization of processes, systems and techniques to ensure successful authorization.


* Proven ability to identify gaps and problems from review of documentation, determine lasting solutions, make effective decisions, and take necessary corrective action.


* Demonstrate excellent leadership capabilities.


* Ability to effectively teach and demonstrate proper interactions with patients and prescribers in a manner that is easy to grasp and allows for interactive learning.


* Enjoys working in a team\-oriented, service\-focused environment.


* Demonstrate extreme attention to detail and accuracy.


* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.


* Basic computer proficiency.


* Knowledge in the use of Microsoft applications.

jobs.title: Enablement and Learning Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise \- it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.

We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real\-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.

Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest\-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.

If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.
### **What you will do**

* Author Sysdig's enablement charter and operating model — what enablement owns, how success is measured, and how it's inspected — and get sign\-off from Sales, CS, and RevOps leadership.
* Own new\-hire onboarding and the certification framework for GTM roles, with a clear, measured path to productivity. Build the ongoing recertification cadence so the program holds up as the team and product evolve.
* Drive adoption and reinforcement of our sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) and equip managers to coach it day\-to\-day. Coordinate delivery for major GTM moments like SKO and product launches, partnering with Product Marketing, who owns the underlying content.
* Own the enablement tech stack (LMS, conversation intelligence) and drive structured adoption of AI\-native GTM tools like Clay and enterprise Claude across the revenue org — role\-based training and champions, not one\-off demos.
* Build and maintain the enablement KPI scorecard — leading indicators like training completion and certification pass rates, lagging indicators like ramp time and win rate — and use it to show where programs are and aren't moving the business.
* Partner with Product Marketing on content adoption (they create, including battlecards; you drive field usage), RevOps on systems and reporting, and Sales/CS leadership to keep the roadmap tied to real pipeline and retention priorities.

### **What you will bring with you**

* 5–8\+ years in sales, revenue, or GTM enablement, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a program (not just running an existing one).
* A track record of designing measurement frameworks
* Hands\-on fluency with modern GTM and enablement tooling: LMS/content platforms, conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong), and AI\-native GTM tools (e.g., Clay) and enterprise AI assistants (e.g., Claude) — you direct these tools and drive adoption, not just use them yourself.
* Experience with a sales methodology framework (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and reinforcing it through coaching, not just a slide deck.
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills — you can align Sales, CS, RevOps, and Product Marketing around a shared enablement plan without owning their turf.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable defining charter and structure where none exists yet, and comfortable being judged on adoption and business metrics, not activity.

### **What we look for**

* Prior enablement experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or infrastructure software.
* Experience standing up or significantly evolving an enablement function at a company going through a platform or GTM transformation.
* Experience running AI adoption/change\-management programs (usage metrics, champions programs, structured rollout) rather than ad hoc tool training.

### **When you join Sysdig, you can expect**


* Extra days off to prioritize your well\-being
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match
* Maternity and Parental Leave
* Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app
* Full health benefits package for you and your family
The U.S. annual salary range for this full\-time position is between 128,000 and 160,000 USD/year. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job\-related experience and education.

We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different.

*Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal\-opportunity employer. Sysdig does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.*

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an energetic and strategic Business Operations Manager to lead and optimize our company's core functions. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind streamlining operations, managing financial performance, and supporting business growth initiatives. The ideal candidate is a proactive leader with a passion for data\-driven decision making, team development, and operational excellence. You will work closely with executive leadership to develop strategies that enhance efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction in a dynamic environment.

**Duties**

* Oversee daily business operations, ensuring processes run smoothly and efficiently across departments.
* Lead strategic planning efforts to align operational goals with overall business objectives.
* Manage profit \& loss statements, analyzing financial data to identify opportunities for cost savings and revenue growth.
* Supervise teams at various levels, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
* Implement process improvements using lean management principles to increase productivity and reduce waste.
* Coordinate projects related to business development, operational upgrades, and new initiatives with cross\-functional teams.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders through excellent managerial communication and customer service.

**Skills**

* Proven experience in management, business management, or operations management roles.
* Strong proficiency in Excel data analysis for reporting and decision\-making purposes.
* Excellent project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities effectively.
* Deep understanding of financial management, profit \& loss analysis, and strategic planning.
* Leadership qualities with experience in team management, team development, and executive\-level team collaboration.
* Skilled in process improvement methodologies such as lean management to optimize workflows.
* Effective supervisory experience combined with strong managerial communication skills to motivate teams and communicate strategies clearly.

Join us as a Business Operations Manager where your leadership will shape the future of our organization’s success!

Pay: $40\.00 \- $44\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 – 50\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager
jobs.description:
**The Position:**

The Lead Project Manager position plays an important role with this rapidly growing company. This is a very dynamic and fast\-track position reporting to the Director, Sales. The position will be a key member of the operations team, responsible for the contract and project execution for SYNEREX. This position will be the technical, project execution, and commercial point of contact for SYNEREX’s customers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Contract Management:**

* Review Supply Agreements and extract obligations agreed to by SYNEREX, the Customer, and relevant parties to develop a project deliverables list.
* Manage these obligations by working with customers, SYNEREX team members (Account Manager, Application Engineer, Product Management, Order Entry, Logistics, Service, and relevant external parties) to ensure successful and timely execution of these obligations.

**Project Management**

* Manage customer relationships, manage resources to resolve issues, and negotiate resolutions to issues causing delays in delivery of products and completion of contract obligations.
* Inform sales and management of project status; and judiciously escalate issues for management assistance if necessary.
* Work collaboratively with internal and external resources across disciplines and organizational lines to define project priorities and work plans.
* Meet objectives for schedule milestones, estimate resources, and coordinate commissioning resources to provide effective early\-stage project development support.
* Ensure projects are efficiently, effectively, and safely executed in accordance with department procedures and policies.
* Manage definition of planned work, ensure validation of completed work, approve contractor payment requests.
* Verify procedures, equipment, and resource allocations to manage conflicts and resolve issues as needed.
* Lead project meetings with customers and internal resources during manufacturing, shipping, installation, and commissioning. Maintain risk tracker and contingency plans for the projects.
* Oversee commissioning activities and ensure they meet corporate objectives for scheduling and resource allocation.
* Determine site specific requirements including labor, local AHJ requirements, safety requirements, utility interconnection, and permit costs.
* Work with Product Management, Sales Management and Application Engineers to generate the field information required for skid integration in the field.
* Review drawings and develop and manage execution plans with third parties and the SYNEREX field service group.
* Manage customer communication on a routine basis to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Assist with the development and negotiation of sub\-contractor, consultant and engineering agreements including safety plans, schedules, and scope\-of\-work necessary to fulfill project requirements.
* Manage all aspects of the project schedule from project kickoff to project close\-out to project post\-mortem meeting.
* Monitor processes, materials, safety, job quality, to detect or assess problems and provide early responses.
* Coordinate inspections and interconnections with the customer.
* Ensure projects are completed within scheduled timeframes and budget.
* Coordinate project commissioning and handoff to systems support and/or O\&M team.
* Coordinate customer training and acceptance.
* Conduct site visits, experimental investigations and analyze engineering problems, propose solutions and alternatives, and provide recommendations.

**Field Service Support**

* Support escalation activities that require high level of coordination and an expedited response to the customer, such as retrofit projects, site upgrades, failure analyses, repairs, etc.
* Keep statistics and information to feed back to the service organization to provide a higher level of customer service.

**Work Location and Status:**

* Remote, Fulltime.
* Travel: 0% to 15%

Pay: $145,000\.00 \- $190,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 5% Match
* 401(k) matching
* Cell phone reimbursement
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

### **Senior Research Project Manager, CHEER**


* 51174
* Remote, United States
* Full Time
  

**Position**: Senior Research Project Manager

**Department**: Pediatrics Research

**Schedule**: 40 hours per week, Remote

**POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Center for Health Equity, Education, and Research (CHEER) at Boston Medical Center is a world\-class center for maternal child health advocacy, training and research. Its mission is to bring about health equity by collaborating with community\-based partners and providing technical assistance, training, evaluation, and inspiration. CHEER focuses on underserved populations, with a particular emphasis on maternal child health and nutrition.

  

Under the supervision of CHEER’s Director and Associate Director, the Senior Research Project Manager (SRPM) will support the CHAMPS National program. CHAMPS is a hospital\-based initiative that promotes evidence\-based maternity practices, with the ultimate goal of increasing breastfeeding rates and decreasing racial disparities in breastfeeding. The new CHAMPS National program is a CDC funded program, which expands hospital enrollment to 100 sites around the US and its territories. The SRPM will develop protocols, assessment instruments, monitor program implementation, provide training, and assist with manuscripts, presentations and reporting to the CDC. The SRPM will provide support to CHAMPS National hospitals, enabling access to trainings, resources, and QI training. The SRPM will function as liaisons between CHAMPS National team members, QI specialists, and trainers, and hospital contacts.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**(These generally will be required but may not always apply based on department\-specific needs):**

 **Project Management**

* Coordinates and facilitates the research project management life cycle, including initiation, development, and implementation of various complex experimentation projects.
* Collaborates with other BU departments and universities on joint projects.
* Offers training and assistance to other facilities working with the CHEER program, provides expert guidance and direct assistance.
* Oversees outreach to facilities in different locations.
* Responsible for scoping, coordinating early research activities, training program staff, and managing implementation of QI training, and research.
* Coordinates research and hospital teams, and manages project timelines, to ensure milestones are completed within the specified and in line with annual objectives.
* Meets regularly with stakeholders, including research staff, contractors, project and study teams, to collect and communicate business and research requirements, and set expectations for research\-related work.
* Responsible for the completion of both research and project management deliverables, including project plans and research schedules, progress reports and investigational applications.

 **Research Management**

* Works with Principal Investigators to select the most appropriate methodology and techniques for facilitating the research.
* Responsible for producing qualitative and quantitative research plans, designing questionnaires and moderator guides.
* Works with research and program implementation teams (BMC based and off\-site), and the project and research directors, to coordinate fieldwork initiatives, and conduct pre\-research and post\-research analyses and evaluations.
* Works with research team to facilitate \& ensure protocol adherence, quality assurance and HIPAA compliance.
* Oversees data collection onsite and offsite, summarizes and interprets data.
* Collaborates with Principal Investigator to author journal articles and to present findings at research seminars, study groups and conferences.

 **Staff Management**

* Supervise support staff (e.g., Research Coordinators, Research Assistants, etc), including training, delegating tasks, overseeing daily activities, mentoring, guiding through demonstration of best practices and offering opportunities for professional development.
* Schedules and facilitates staff meetings. Plans agenda and ensures that minutes are taken, edited and distributed.

 **Administrative Duties**

* Assists the Principal Investigator with monitoring expenses, facilitating contracts, ordering materials and documenting all approved variances. Works with offsite team to oversee program expenses and offer guidance.
* Liaises as necessary with Institutional Review Board (IRB) for submissions, correspondence, and regulatory binders, including administrative amendments.
* Assists with development and writing of proposals to obtain funding for ongoing and future research activities.
* Perform administrative duties associated with the study’s Data Monitoring and Safety Board, tracking and reporting adverse events and collecting data specified by the DMSB. Responsible for all other administrative duties related to research activities.
* Performs other duties as required.

 **DEPARTMENT\-SPECIFIC DUTIES**

**DEPARTMENT: Division of General Pediatrics**

jobs.description:
**About Lyra Health**
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence\-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.  

  

**About The Role**



We are seeking a high\-performing and highly organized **Senior Operations Lead, Core Operations (Transformation)** to serve as a key strategic thinker and execution driver within the Transformation Operations team. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Core Operations (Transformation), the Senior Operations Lead will drive the end\-to\-end operational planning, execution, and change enablement for high\-priority and time\-bound strategic projects across Clinical Operations. This role requires high level communication skills, the ability to partner cross\-functionally on sensitive and key projects, mental agility, and a meticulous approach to managing a portfolio of complex projects.



### **Responsibilities:**


* **Project Leadership \& Execution:** Own the full project lifecycle and drive the day\-to\-day execution for assigned strategic initiatives, such as the ongoing Engage rollout and 2026/2027 new launch preparation (e.g., Neuropsych, Exclusive Outpatient Network, Lyra AI).
* **Structure \& Roadmapping:** Translate high\-level goals into clear, actionable roadmaps and project plans for internal teams and Service Line Leads ("clients"). Designs the overall scope and sets up the initial structure for medium to large cross\-functional teams; actively supports more junior team members in creating materials and facilitating successful cross\-functional meetings.
* **Change Enablement Driver:** Actively takes independent initiative to address key operational or team challenges, manage multiple operational projects or a complex operational project with little to no support, and actively direct efforts of more junior and senior Op team members as well as cross\-functional partners to achieve aggressive deadlines.

* **Risk Mitigation:** Triage and resolve complex project roadblocks, escalating high\-stakes risks and challenges.

* Experience: Minimum of 10\+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree in business operations, management consulting, program management, or related field, preferably within healthcare or high\-growth tech environments.

* Actively takes independent initiative to address key operational or team challenges, manage multiple operational projects or a complex operational project with little to no support, and actively direct efforts of more junior and senior Op team members as well as cross\-functional partners to achieve aggressive deadlines.

* Tool Expertise: Fluent in multiple systems and has a clear perspective on the best way to deploy them/upskill others on their use in order to improve overall team productivity. Mastery of project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet) for complex resource and dependency tracking.

 As a full\-time Senior Ops Lead, Core Operations , you will be employed by Lyra Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $119,000 \- 183,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience and location. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.
  

  

Annual salary is only one part of an employee’s total compensation package at Lyra. We also offer generous benefits that include:
  

  

Comprehensive healthcare coverage (including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, life and disability insurances)  

Lyra for Lyrians; coaching and therapy services  

Equity in the company through discretionary restricted stock units  

Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays

jobs.title: NGS Project Manager
jobs.description:
Predicine is a Silicon Valley\-based global precision medicine company that is committed to developing the first\- and best\-in\-class liquid biopsy cancer diagnostics and precision medicine portfolio to address the unmet medical needs in global drug development. We have developed an innovative liquid biopsy technology that is empowering biopharma partners in clinical drug development and oncology medicine research. Our international business services provide molecular insights to the top 10 MNC BioPharma’s to support biomarker\-driven clinical trials in US, EU, APAC including China. We believe our most important asset is our people and are dedicated to maintaining a thriving workplace. We value a culture of Integrity, Innovation, Quality, Respect, Courage, Collaboration, Caring, and Communication.


We are seeking a highly skilled and organized NGS Lab Project Manager to join the Lab Service Management team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in molecular biology, and project coordination with NGS workflow experience, to support projects in the Predicine NGS Operations portfolio.


What you will get to do:

* Project Management:
	+ Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of NGS\-based projects, ensuring alignment with project timelines, budgets, and resources.
	+ Develop detailed project plans, outlining milestones, deliverables, and responsibilities.
	+ Coordinate with cross\-functional teams (scientists, bioinformaticians, quality control specialists) to ensure seamless execution of NGS workflows.
	+ Communicate progress and timelines towards company goals through daily and weekly updates.
	+ Manage project risks and resolve any issues or bottlenecks that arise.
	+ Document and track projects using systems such as JIRA, Confluence, or other PM\-related software.
* Client and Stakeholder Communication:
	+ Serve as the primary contact for clients regarding project updates, timelines, and outcomes.
	+ Provide regular reports on project progress, including data analysis, and prepare presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
	+ Manage expectations and resolve any concerns related to project timelines or deliverables.
* Data and Quality Assurance:
	+ Ensure data quality, accuracy, to maintain high standards of quality control.
	+ Support troubleshooting efforts for any discrepancies in data.
* Documentation and Compliance:
	+ Maintain accurate project documentation, including protocols, project timelines, and client communications.
	+ Ensure compliance with all regulatory and ethical standards, including relevant industry guidelines for NGS applications.
* The role will support occasional off\-hours and weekend communications, as required, for both internal and external stakeholders.


To be successful in this role:

* Education:
	+ Bachelor’s degree in molecular biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field. A Master's or PhD (Preferred)
* Experience:
	+ Minimum of 2 years of experience managing NGS\-related projects or laboratory operations, with a proven track record in project management.
* Skills:
	+ Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
	+ Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
	+ Proficient in project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Asana, Jira) and basic office software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace).
* Certifications:
	+ PMP (Project Management Professional) or similar project management certification is a plus.


Work Environment:  

This position requires a combination of office\-based work and laboratory\-based tasks. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to meet project deadlines.


Benefits:  

We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth and development.


Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, for eligible employees and their dependents. Other benefits include stock allocation and 401k benefits, 4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years of service, lunch provided daily for onsite employees.


Our Opportunity  

Predicine is a global molecular insights company that is committed to advancing precision medicine in oncology. Predicine has developed a breakthrough cell\-free DNA\- and cell\-free RNA\-based liquid biopsy technology enabling minimally invasive molecular diagnosis for treatment selection, therapy monitoring, and minimal residual disease and early cancer detection. The company has launched a portfolio of blood\-urine\- and tissue\-based diagnostic assays for oncology.


We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.  All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

The Project Manager, Product Delivery is a high\-impact individual contributor role responsible for executing and safeguarding the post\-contract product delivery pipeline within the Ford Energy Aftersales Organization. As a principal individual contributor, you will directly oversee the execution of Ford Energy's most strategic and complex deployments while helping to shape and apply standardized PMO processes, delivery playbooks, and stage\-gate controls for the organization.

  

What you'll do...

Delivery Process Execution:

  

* Standardized Execution: Apply and help continuously improve standardized post\-contract delivery processes, playbooks, and stage\-gate reviews tailored for BESS projects.
* Portfolio Health: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for project health, delivery efficiency, and financial performance across assigned Ford Energy projects.
* Tools \& Systems: Utilize and provide feedback on advanced program management tools and tracking systems to ensure consistent execution.


High\-Stakes Project Execution:

* Direct Delivery: Take personal accountability for the execution, timeline, and commissioning of Ford Energy's largest, most complex, or high\-risk utility\-scale BESS installations.
* Risk Mitigation: Conduct rigorous stakeholder and risk analyses to identify deployment hurdles and coordinate cross\-functional interventions to unblock delivery pipelines.
* Technical \& Operational Alignment: Act as the primary interface between Sales, Service, Engineering, Finance, and external EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contractors to ensure aligned execution.


Stakeholder \& Customer Management

* Primary Escalation Contact: Serve as the prime operational contact and consultant for customers, utilities, and senior internal leadership during project deployment.
* Contractual Coordination: Navigate and resolve complex contractual, scheduling, and technical coordination issues with external partners and utility representatives.
* Peer Mentorship: Provide functional guidance and mentorship to other project specialists and engineers across the organization.


You'll have...  

  

Required:

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Construction
* Management, a related technical field, or equivalent.
* Experience: 10\+ years of program management, project delivery, or PMO experience, with a proven track record of executing large\-scale utility, infrastructure, or energy projects.
* Execution Expertise: Strong background in post\-contract execution, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) workflows, contract management, and utility\-scale deployments.
* Collaboration Capability: Proven ability to influence and drive consensus across matrixed, cross\-functional engineering and business teams without direct authority.


Even better, you may have...


Preferred:

* Master's degree or MBA.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or PgMP (Program Management Professional) certification.
* Deep domain knowledge of BESS, grid\-scale power systems, or renewable energy project lifecycles.

  

Key Attributes:

  

* Process\-Oriented Executor: Able to apply and reinforce standardized project delivery frameworks and PMO guidelines, ensuring operational readiness for complex deployments.
* Collaborative Facilitator: Skilled at bridging gaps and building operational consensus between Sales, Aftersales, Engineering, Finance, and external partners to drive aligned execution.
* Execution Champion: Maintains a hands\-on, relentless focus on delivery timelines, quality, and project financials, ensuring our most complex commitments to customers are met successfully.
* Team Contributor: Passionate about sharing knowledge and elevating project delivery capabilities across the organization, with the readiness to foster a collaborative team culture as the function grows.


Location \& Travel:

* Location: Dearborn, MI or Glendale, KY. This position operates on a hybrid model, requiring regular onsite presence to collaborate with engineering, sales, aftersales, and manufacturing leadership.

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
