jobs.title: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Reporting & Compliance Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive Affordable Care Act (ACA) reporting and compliance services. Our team of seasoned ACA specialists, data integration experts, in\-house legal counsel, and accounting professionals delivers accurate, efficient, and trustworthy service to every client.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Manager to lead the process behind our ACA compliance deliverables. This role does not focus on finding or fixing every error directly \- rather, it focuses on catching the exceptions: patterns, inconsistencies, and edge cases that indicate a deliverable isn't ready for client review.

As the QA Manager, you will oversee the review of completed ACA Forms 1094\-C and 1095\-C work prepared by our analyst team, verify that coding and documentation meet internal standards, and ensure every deliverable is accurate, defensible, and audit\-ready before it reaches the client. This role requires technical knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements, and sharp pattern\-recognition skills.

If you enjoy digging into data to find the exception that everyone else missed, thrive under deadline pressure, and take pride in building a team that delivers accurate ACA reporting and compliance work, we look forward to hearing from you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review completed ACA reporting deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to client delivery
* Verify Line 14, 15, and 16 coding against plan details, employee eligibility, classification, enrollment, and affordability requirements
* Identify coding inconsistencies between current and prior filing years, and confirm that any changes are properly explained
* Run and review error reports to catch missing data, incorrect codes, or discrepancies between source files and final output
* Cross\-check questionnaire responses against how each case was actually coded and processed
* Verify that every enrolled individual is accounted for, appropriately documented, and matched with a corresponding form
* Spot\-check high\-risk scenarios, including mid\-year terminations, rehires, status changes, and multi\-FEIN employers
* Ensure findings, exceptions, and assumptions are clearly documented in tickets and supporting files
* Maintain consistent file naming, folder structure, and documentation standards across the QA process
* Provide feedback to analysts to improve accuracy and reduce recurring errors
* Collaborate with account managers and analysts to resolve open questions before deliverables are finalized

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excel Proficiency: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX / MATCH, Pivot Tables, Nested IF statements, Logical / Array formulas
* Minimum of two years hands\-on experience preparing Forms 1094 and 1095 C\-series. B series and/or ICHRA experience is a plus
* Working knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements under IRC §6055 and §6056
* Strong understanding of Line 14/15/16 coding logic, safe harbor determinations, and affordability analysis
* High attention to detail and the ability to identify patterns or anomalies across large, multi\-source datasets
* Strong written communication skills for documenting findings, exceptions, and client\-facing notes
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, remote environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience leading, training, or mentoring
* Experience with quality assurance, audit, or error\-report review processes
* Exposure to HRIS/payroll data sources (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, UKG, Employee Navigator)
* Prior experience in a client\-facing or project coordination role
* Familiarity with Excel add\-ins such as Power Query that streamline data cleanup and processing.

**Interview Process**

As a remote team, we require applicants to demonstrate their ability to work independently via an Excel\-based **Technical Abilities Assessment**.

If your qualifications and experience are a match, you will receive an invitation to schedule the day and time of assessment. A packet including detailed instructions for processing and submission will then be sent for completion within 90 minutes or less.

**Why Join Us?**

* A clear path for growth, salary increases, and seasonal bonuses based on performance
* Hands\-on leadership role shaping the quality and accuracy of every client deliverable
* Work with a supportive, collaborative team of ACA specialists, data experts, and compliance professionals
* Opportunity to mentor and develop a growing analyst team
* Learn and help refine industry best practices in ACA compliance quality control
* Work environment that values precision, accountability, and getting it right the first time

**Job Details**

* Job Type: Full\-Time
* Compensation: $70,000 – $100,000
* Pay Basis: Salaried
* Work Location: Remote
* Schedule: Regular Business Hours plus availability during ACA peak filing season (December–April), including some evenings and weekends as deadlines required
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) \+ Match, Ancillary (*Details at offer stage*), Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Performance\-based Bonus
* Background check and confidentiality agreement required, given the sensitivity of the data handled in this role

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you been responsible for reviewing or approving another person's ACA reporting work before it went to a client?
* Which of the following have you used unassisted in the past 12 months? (Select all that apply): INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Nested IF/IFS, None of these

Experience:

* ACA 1094 and 1095 Reporting: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Maintenance Training Manager
jobs.description:
The Maintenance Training Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing technical training programs for aircraft maintenance personnel within the organization. This position ensures maintenance training programs meet FAA regulations, OEM standards, and internal safety and quality requirements.



The Maintenance Training Manager oversees training schedules, tracks certifications, conducts audits, evaluates training effectiveness, and works closely with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational stakeholders to ensure maintenance personnel remain proficient, compliant, and prepared to support safe air medical operations.

  


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive technical training programs for maintenance personnel.
* Develop training materials including presentations, manuals, assessments, interactive e learning modules, and other instructional resources.
* Conduct training\-needs assessments and identify skill, competency, and performance gaps.
* Deliver engaging training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, simulations, group discussions, and other instructional methods.
* Conduct audits to ensure compliance with company policies and applicable industry regulations.
* Review existing training programs and recommend enhancements to improve engagement, learning, retention, and effectiveness.
* Organize and conduct monthly induction and orientation sessions.
* Maintain current knowledge of maintenance software systems, industry best practices, software releases, and emerging technologies.
* Provide ongoing technical support and guidance to maintenance personnel regarding maintenance software systems and functionality.
* Maintain accurate training records, attendance documentation, evaluations, and training materials.
* Prepare reports regarding training outcomes, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain knowledge resources for maintenance software systems.
* Collaborate with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, Regional Managers, software vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects requiring maintenance training expertise.

 **Minimum Required Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of aircraft maintenance practices, technical documentation, maintenance records, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience training, mentoring, coaching, or providing technical instruction to maintenance personnel.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, and/or other instructional methods.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and effectively utilize maintenance, training, and learning\-management software systems.
* Ability to simultaneously manage multiple training initiatives, schedules, records, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational departments.
* Ability to travel as required and work a flexible schedule when operational or training needs require.
* Valid driver's license.
* Regular and reliable attendance.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A\&P) Mechanic Certificate.
* Experience developing, implementing, or managing a formal aviation maintenance training program.
* Experience operating within an FAA Part 135 and/or Part 145 environment.
* Fixed\-wing and/or rotor\-wing aircraft maintenance experience.
* Experience developing curricula, presentations, technical manuals, assessments, e\-learning content, or other instructional materials.
* Knowledge of adult\-learning principles, instructional design, competency\-based training, and training evaluation methods.
* Experience conducting or supporting maintenance audits, quality assurance activities, regulatory inspections, or compliance reviews.
* Experience with computerized maintenance tracking systems, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and electronic training\-record systems.
* Familiarity with FAA regulations, OEM maintenance requirements, Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and other applicable technical or regulatory guidance.
* Experience analyzing training needs, identifying competency or performance gaps, and implementing corrective training.
* Experience within air medical, EMS aviation, or another safety\-sensitive aviation environment.

  


**Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements**  

This position primarily operates in an office environment with occasional exposure to hangar facilities. The position requires prolonged periods of sitting and computer work, frequent verbal and written communication, and the ability to read documents and computer screens.



The position may require lifting up to 50 pounds, navigating organizational facilities, traveling as needed, and working a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends. Occasional exposure to hazardous materials, loud noise, and extreme temperatures may occur.

jobs.description:
At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech\-forward, growth driven culture. With 85\+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably.
  
We're looking for bold thinkers, builders, technologists, and sellers who want real ownership of their work, thrive in collaborative environments, and are energized by solving complex challenges. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact \- fast.
  
If you're eager to shape the future of cross\-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.

* High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or related field preferred.\\
* 4\+ years of experience in bank operations, partner support, or financial services.
* Experience in settlement reconciliation, inventory management, and troubleshooting technical issues.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex financial issues.

* Strong understanding of financial regulations, audit requirements, and risk mitigation practices.

**About TNT Growth**

TNT Growth is a performance marketing agency operating at the intersection of growth strategy, paid media, and creative production for DTC and B2B brands. **About This Role**
===================


We’re hiring a Business Operations Associate to join our team on a contract\-to\-hire basis. This role has two phases:

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–12\):** You’ll serve as interim operational coverage during a planned leadership leave, working directly with the CEO and department leads across finance, people operations, and company operations. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility period where you’ll keep critical business functions running smoothly.

**Phase 2 (Ongoing):** Once the leave period ends, the role transitions to its permanent scope — owning the day\-to\-day of people operations support, project management, operational reporting, and cross\-functional coordination. If the contract goes well, you convert to full\-time with an expanded seat on the business operations team.

**Phase 1: Interim Responsibilities (Weeks 1–12\)**
===================================================


During the leave period, you will be the operational point person across finance and company operations. The CEO will retain final decision\-making authority, but you are responsible for the day\-to\-day execution, triage, and follow\-through.

* **Contractor invoice review:** Review incoming contractor invoices against the financial forecast. Flag discrepancies, missing costs, or new vendors not yet in projections to Finance and escalate to the CEO as needed.

Catch orphaned subscriptions, duplicate tools, and charges on the wrong card. Coordinate card migrations when team members depart or change roles.

**Company Operations**

* **Executive meeting support:** Prepare agendas, track action items, and maintain documentation for the weekly executive meeting. Ensure follow\-through on decisions made in leadership meetings.

* **Contract management support:** Support Client Success and Sales with active contract management — tracking signature status on addendums, SOWs, and new agreements. Flag renewals and ensure in\-progress contracts don’t stall.

* **Cross\-department coordination:** Serve as the operational connective tissue between Finance, People Ops, Client Success, and department leads. Triage incoming operational requests and route them to the right owner.
* **Performance review execution:** Partner with the People \& Talent Lead to execute the end\-of\-year performance review cycle — coordinating timelines, compiling self\-assessments and manager feedback, and ensuring reviews are completed on schedule across all departments.

**Phase 2: Ongoing Responsibilities**
=====================================


After the leave period, this role settles into its permanent scope. You’ll continue to own and build on the areas below as the company scales.

Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

The Play store serves more than 2\.5B users across over 190 countries, and is a critical driver of Google’s overall business growth. Googlers working on the Play Go\-To\-Market (GTM) teams own content strategy and publishing within the Play Store across all regions and verticals (Apps, Games, and more).


As a Program Manager, you will work on a large portfolio of innovative products and programs such as new and engaging mechanics that can enhance user engagement while strengthening proven capabilities to improve scalability and robustness.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with all of the teams involved with Go\-To\-Market programs and tooling solutions including product marketing, product, engineering, finance, partnerships, operations, and more to create and execute GTM plans, manage launches, and scale the business.


Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

**About Jetson**



Jetson is on a mission to accelerate the transition of 100 million homes across North America away from fossil fuels toward sustainable energy use. We believe in a future that is 100% electric and 100% better.



Homes are one of the largest sources of carbon emissions, yet adoption of solutions like heat pumps remains slow due to cost and complexity. Jetson is solving this by building the first fully vertically integrated home electrification company — making clean energy simple, transparent, and affordable.



We rely heavily on technology, automation, and data to scale this impact. At Jetson, we value people who are excellent at their craft, curious about new tools (including AI), and motivated to continuously improve how work gets done.

  


#### **The Opportunity:**



We are looking for an extremely motivated and passionate HVAC professional with field operations management who would like to be a part of an exciting new company looking to fight climate change through disrupting the residential HVAC industry. This marks our expansion in the California market. The Field Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the HVAC installation teams are fully supported and equipped to perform their work safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. This role bridges field operations and leadership, with a focus on readiness, resource allocation, and real\-time problem\-solving to drive team success. As we continue to iterate the processes and procedures that ensure the highest installation quality and efficiency, this role will play an integral role by contributing to the knowledge base.


#### **What You Will Do:**


* Ensure daily readiness of field teams by coordinating tools, equipment, vehicles, parts, and job documentation.
* Act as the primary liaison between the field crew and internal departments such as logistics, procurement, and scheduling.
* Conduct site visits to provide support, coaching, and quality assurance for active installation projects.
* Monitor and enforce company safety standards and ensure compliance with local codes and regulations.
* Identify operational obstacles and work proactively to resolve issues that impact field productivity or installation timelines.
* Conduct pre\-installation walkthroughs to ensure all project parameters
* Maintain an up\-to\-date understanding of the staffing needs based relevant business inputs.
* Train and mentor field technicians to improve workmanship, efficiency, and customer service.
* Review completed installations to ensure quality standards and customer expectations are met or exceeded.
* Support warranty and rework investigations and help implement corrective action plans.
* Provide performance feedback and assist with evaluations of field team members.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and refine operational procedures and best practices.

#### **What You Bring:**


* Proven experience as an HVAC install team member and team lead.
* GA Conditioned Air Contractor (CAC) — Class I Restricted (State, RME Required; \#1 Gating Item)
* HVAC NATE and Section 608 certification preferred.
* 5\+ years in a management role, overseeing field teams.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems including heat pumps.
* Ability to lead, coach, and motivate field personnel.
* Ability to read blueprints and schematics.
* Familiarity with building codes and regulations.
* Excellent English communications and customer service skills.
* Proficiency with scheduling software, mobile work apps, field management tools and general business tools expertise.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
* Excellent problem\-solving and organizational skills.
* Follows OSHA Electrical Standard
* Follows the Occupational Safety and Health Administration's (OSHA) Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) standard


**Job Type:**Full\-time, Permanent


**Pay:** **$115K \- $125K per year**


#### **Benefits:**



Dental Care, Vision Care \& Life Insurance premiums fully paid by Jetson



Health Insurance premium 85% paid by Jetson


Education Support



Parental Leave Top Up



401k program



Paid Tim Off to include Company Paid shut down from Dec 24th to Jan 1st



Holiday Pay

Intuit's CTREC organization (Cybersecurity, Trust \& Safety, Risk, Enterprise Systems and Compliance) protects the company and powers the technology experiences of our global workforce. new_jobs.title: Device Safety & Risk Operations Specialist, User Safety & Risk Operations
new_jobs.description:
Trust \& Safety \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


At OpenAIs of misuse. We operate at the front line of real\-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems.


This role sits on a team focused on building operational capacity for new, ambiguous, and fast\-moving areas of work. The team defines what needs to be built, creates the operating model to support it, and works with partner teams to make the work scalable and durable over time.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Device Safety \& Risk Operations Specialist to build the safety operating model for a new category of consumer hardware. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for someone who can turn emerging product risks and incomplete requirements into practical workflows, controls, launch plans, and durable systems.


You will define how product\-safety incidents, critical escalations, regulated cases, and privacy\-sensitive issues should be identified, investigated, escalated, resolved, and learned from. You will also establish operational requirements for case management, data access, decision logging, quality assurance, monitoring, and cross\-functional response. You will stand up priority workflows through launch and early operations, then help transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams.


The right person combines deep operational judgment with strong technical and hardware product fluency. They can move from executive\-level risk framing to detailed workflow design, tabletop exercises, launch readiness, frontline guidance, and post\-launch improvement.


Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in\-office.


Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning material. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential.

  

  

**In This Role, You Will:**


* Build the end\-to\-end safety and risk operating model for new consumer hardware, from early requirements through launch and early\-life operations.
* Define incident taxonomies, severity levels, decision rights, escalation criteria, response pathways, and closure standards.
* Develop operational playbooks for product\-safety incidents, critical escalations, safety advisories, corrective actions, and other high\-risk events.
* Design workflows for regulated and privacy\-sensitive cases, including restricted handling, evidence requirements, auditability, and partner escalation.
* Translate safety and operational needs into requirements for tooling, case management, data access, monitoring, logging, and automation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries across Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Product Policy, Support, Product Quality, and other operational partners.
* Build launch\-readiness plans, tabletop exercises, training, quality controls, reporting, and post\-launch monitoring.
* Use operational data, customer signals, product telemetry, and case outcomes to identify patterns and improve upstream products and systems.
* Determine where AI and automation can improve triage, evidence assembly, consistency, and response while preserving appropriate human judgment.
* Stand up priority workflows, operate them through launch and early\-life stabilization, and transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You:**


* Have 8\+ years of relevant experience in device safety, product safety, consumer hardware operations, technical program management, or a related field.
* Have built a complex safety or risk program from an ambiguous starting point through launch and scaled operation.
* Understand the realities of handling high\-severity incidentsation, and time\-critical escalations.
* Can translate product, engineering, legal, privacy, and policy constraints into workflows that operational teams can execute.
* Are technically fluent and can reason through data flows, telemetry, access controls, audit logs, case systems, automation, and failure modes.
* Use data to assess workflow health, identify emerging patterns, evaluate quality, and make risk\-based decisions.
* Can establish clear accountability across teams with overlapping responsibilities and different risk tolerances.
* Know how to balance launch speed with safety controls, monitoring, rollback criteria, and longer\-term system development.
* Communicate clearly with operational, technical, legal, and executive audiences when evidence is incomplete or tradeoffs are difficult.
* Are highly practical and willing to build the workflow, not only define the strategy.
* Experience supporting consumer hardware, connected devices, or other products used in shared environments.
* Experience with product\-safety investigations, recalls, field failures, safety advisories, or hazardous\-product handling.
* Experience designing workflows involving privacy\-sensitive sensor, diagnostic, media, or household data.
* Familiarity with warranty, repair, reverse logistics, identity recovery, fraud, or ownership disputes.
* Experience building vendor training, quality\-assurance, incident\-response, or specialist\-review programs.

**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.


We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

new_jobs.description:
Security \- San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, and Washington, DC

  


**About the Team**


Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is foundational to Security delivering mission outcomes at OpenAI. The GRC team provides security assurances and builds compliance for OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but operational in how we do our work, and we partner deeply with Product, Security, Legal, Privacy, GTM, and Field Security to help OpenAI move quickly while maintaining trust with customers, auditors, regulators, and the public.


**About the Role**


We are looking for an experienced Product Lifecycle Assurance IC to help scale OpenAI’s GRC function across our product stack to ensure products address customer and regulatory compliance requirements at launch and regressions are detected promptly and corrected.


You will partner closely with Product, Security, Legal, and Privacy teams to make sure OpenAI can move quickly while maintaining our security, privacy and compliance claims and giving customers, auditors, and regulators assurance about how OpenAI handles user data. You are responsible for product assurance end\-to\-end from inception to post\-launch (continuous) monitoring. You leverage existing workflows, reviews, and data and enhance, augment and build the components needed to create an end\-to\-end product assurance program.


This role is **not** about supporting SOC or ISO audits; it's a highly cross\-functional and deeply technical operations role to ensure that OAI products meet the compliance bar at launch, regressions are prevented and detected, and our compliance state can be evidenced. This role also helps ensure that our product launch governance program operates effectively across key safety, privacy, legal and security stakeholders and lessons\-learned from incidents and regressions are used to improve the program.


You or in partnership with engineering teamsation needed to design and launch safety and meet them where they are. You exercise sound judgement in making high\-stakes decisions related to product launch risk and controls.


You are comfortable working in high velocity, low friction development environments. Your work goes across team boundaries and you assist and enable other teams to realize product assurance objectives. You should be comfortable with complex (Kubernetes) system architectures and dataflows, working with engineering teams to understand what could go wrong and where and how controls should be applied. You should be comfortable working with Privacy engineering and Data Science to understand data maps and database schemas and leverage existing processes and controls to further product assurance goals.


**We’re looking for people who bring:**


* Strong technical product lifecycle assurance and security and privacy compliance experience working in high velocity, low friction development environments.
* Experience building technical controls, metrics, monitoring tools, CI/CD tooling, high\-fidelity risk signals and dashboards to meet product assurance goals
* Ability to run an end\-to\-end, cross\-functional, product assurance program applying judgement where what type of process or controls should be in place to meet a high assurance bar
* Capacity to shift product assurance to the left in the product development cycle with just\-in\-time controls, guidance, guardrails and responsible friction for developers
* Low ego outcome oriented mindset to achieve the product assurance goal required for OAI’s mission
* Strong technical cross\-functional leadership and don’t work in a vacuum \- they influence, align and direct partner teams to achieve product assurance goals.
* Exercise sound judgement in making high\-stakes decisions related to product launch risk and controls.

**You’ll be responsible for:**


* The end\-to\-end effective operation of OAI’s product assurance program from product development to post\-launch (continuous) monitoring
* Owning the GRC product assurance program, providing governance over Safety, Deployment, Security, Legal reviews to ensure we effectively surface product risk and design scalable mitigations
* Driving cross\-function collaboration and accountability in all aspects of the product assurance program
* Building controls and low\-friction, scalable processes in our infrastructure stack, developer workflows and launch tooling to ensure effective product assurance
* Ensuring that teams have the guidance needed to design and launch safety and meet them where they are
* Ensuring compliance, security and privacy claims and maps to verifiable controls
* Recognizing how the product lifecycle assurance program fits into the large organizational objectives and when to build and when to influence and maintain strong partnerships with partner teams and influence roadmaps to further assurance goals

At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise \- it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.

We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real\-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.

Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest\-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.

If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.
### **What you will do**

* Author Sysdig's enablement charter and operating model — what enablement owns, how success is measured, and how it's inspected — and get sign\-off from Sales, CS, and RevOps leadership.
* Own new\-hire onboarding and the certification framework for GTM roles, with a clear, measured path to productivity. Build the ongoing recertification cadence so the program holds up as the team and product evolve.
* Drive adoption and reinforcement of our sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) and equip managers to coach it day\-to\-day. Coordinate delivery for major GTM moments like SKO and product launches, partnering with Product Marketing, who owns the underlying content.
* Own the enablement tech stack (LMS, conversation intelligence) and drive structured adoption of AI\-native GTM tools like Clay and enterprise Claude across the revenue org — role\-based training and champions, not one\-off demos.
* Build and maintain the enablement KPI scorecard — leading indicators like training completion and certification pass rates, lagging indicators like ramp time and win rate — and use it to show where programs are and aren't moving the business.
* Partner with Product Marketing on content adoption (they create, including battlecards; you drive field usage), RevOps on systems and reporting, and Sales/CS leadership to keep the roadmap tied to real pipeline and retention priorities.

### **What you will bring with you**

* 5–8\+ years in sales, revenue, or GTM enablement, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a program (not just running an existing one).
* A track record of designing measurement frameworks
* Hands\-on fluency with modern GTM and enablement tooling: LMS/content platforms, conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong), and AI\-native GTM tools (e.g., Clay) and enterprise AI assistants (e.g., Claude) — you direct these tools and drive adoption, not just use them yourself.
* Experience with a sales methodology framework (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and reinforcing it through coaching, not just a slide deck.
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills — you can align Sales, CS, RevOps, and Product Marketing around a shared enablement plan without owning their turf.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable defining charter and structure where none exists yet, and comfortable being judged on adoption and business metrics, not activity.

### **What we look for**

* Prior enablement experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or infrastructure software.
* Experience standing up or significantly evolving an enablement function at a company going through a platform or GTM transformation.
* Experience running AI adoption/change\-management programs (usage metrics, champions programs, structured rollout) rather than ad hoc tool training.

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive Affordable Care Act (ACA) reporting and compliance services. Our team of seasoned ACA specialists, data integration experts, in\-house legal counsel, and accounting professionals delivers accurate, efficient, and trustworthy service to every client.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Manager to lead the process behind our ACA compliance deliverables. This role does not focus on finding or fixing every error directly \- rather, it focuses on catching the exceptions: patterns, inconsistencies, and edge cases that indicate a deliverable isn't ready for client review.

As the QA Manager, you will oversee the review of completed ACA Forms 1094\-C and 1095\-C work prepared by our analyst team, verify that coding and documentation meet internal standards, and ensure every deliverable is accurate, defensible, and audit\-ready before it reaches the client. This role requires technical knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements, and sharp pattern\-recognition skills.

If you enjoy digging into data to find the exception that everyone else missed, thrive under deadline pressure, and take pride in building a team that delivers accurate ACA reporting and compliance work, we look forward to hearing from you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review completed ACA reporting deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to client delivery
* Verify Line 14, 15, and 16 coding against plan details, employee eligibility, classification, enrollment, and affordability requirements
* Identify coding inconsistencies between current and prior filing years, and confirm that any changes are properly explained
* Run and review error reports to catch missing data, incorrect codes, or discrepancies between source files and final output
* Cross\-check questionnaire responses against how each case was actually coded and processed
* Verify that every enrolled individual is accounted for, appropriately documented, and matched with a corresponding form
* Spot\-check high\-risk scenarios, including mid\-year terminations, rehires, status changes, and multi\-FEIN employers
* Ensure findings, exceptions, and assumptions are clearly documented in tickets and supporting files
* Maintain consistent file naming, folder structure, and documentation standards across the QA process
* Provide feedback to analysts to improve accuracy and reduce recurring errors
* Collaborate with account managers and analysts to resolve open questions before deliverables are finalized

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excel Proficiency: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX / MATCH, Pivot Tables, Nested IF statements, Logical / Array formulas
* Minimum of two years hands\-on experience preparing Forms 1094 and 1095 C\-series. B series and/or ICHRA experience is a plus
* Working knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements under IRC §6055 and §6056
* Strong understanding of Line 14/15/16 coding logic, safe harbor determinations, and affordability analysis
* High attention to detail and the ability to identify patterns or anomalies across large, multi\-source datasets
* Strong written communication skills for documenting findings, exceptions, and client\-facing notes
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, remote environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience leading, training, or mentoring
* Experience with quality assurance, audit, or error\-report review processes
* Exposure to HRIS/payroll data sources (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, UKG, Employee Navigator)
* Prior experience in a client\-facing or project coordination role
* Familiarity with Excel add\-ins such as Power Query that streamline data cleanup and processing.

**Interview Process**

As a remote team, we require applicants to demonstrate their ability to work independently via an Excel\-based **Technical Abilities Assessment**.

If your qualifications and experience are a match, you will receive an invitation to schedule the day and time of assessment. A packet including detailed instructions for processing and submission will then be sent for completion within 90 minutes or less.

**Why Join Us?**

* A clear path for growth, salary increases, and seasonal bonuses based on performance
* Hands\-on leadership role shaping the quality and accuracy of every client deliverable
* Work with a supportive, collaborative team of ACA specialists, data experts, and compliance professionals
* Opportunity to mentor and develop a growing analyst team
* Learn and help refine industry best practices in ACA compliance quality control
* Work environment that values precision, accountability, and getting it right the first time

**Job Details**

* Job Type: Full\-Time
* Compensation: $70,000 – $100,000
* Pay Basis: Salaried
* Work Location: Remote
* Schedule: Regular Business Hours plus availability during ACA peak filing season (December–April), including some evenings and weekends as deadlines required
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) \+ Match, Ancillary (*Details at offer stage*), Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Performance\-based Bonus
* Background check and confidentiality agreement required, given the sensitivity of the data handled in this role

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you been responsible for reviewing or approving another person's ACA reporting work before it went to a client?
* Which of the following have you used unassisted in the past 12 months? (Select all that apply): INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Nested IF/IFS, None of these

Experience:

* ACA 1094 and 1095 Reporting: 2 years (Preferred)

new_jobs.title: HR Generalist
new_jobs.description:
**Human Resources Generalist**


Are you an HR problem solver looking for a role with greater autonomy? At Modea, we view our talent as a company differentiator, and we are looking for a dedicated HR Generalist to help us build and maintain a strong, supported team.

**What You Will Do**


In this role, you will be a champion of our unique culture while managing the essential operations that keep our business running smoothly. Your key responsibilities include:


Morale and Event Planning

* Support the employee engagement survey cycle at Modea, partnering with managers to continuously respond to employee feedback.
* Champion Modea’s unique company culture through team initiatives and engagement programs.
* Plan and organize employee events and recognition programs such as team\-building activities and annual all\-company meetings.

  

Talent and Team Support

* Partner with hiring managers to attract and select top talent, treating every open role as an opportunity to build a stronger business and elevate our team.
* Facilitate employee growth by guiding both employees and managers through the performance management and development process.
* Collaborate closely with managers to align talent strategies with operational goals.
* Manage employee relations issues and guide managers toward practical, team\-centric solutions.
* Coordinate and execute full employee onboarding and offboarding activities.


Benefits Management

* Support employee enrollment and use of benefits.
* Ensure accurate benefits administration and invoicing across our platform and insurance providers.
* Answer employee inquiries regarding healthcare, 401(k), and leave programs.
* Administer leaves of absence and FMLA, coordinate benefit usage during leave periods, and monitor time\-off trends.


Data and Compliance

* Maintain compliant employee records and perform audits of HR documents, invoices, benefits, and payroll.
* Keep our employee handbook updated and relevant to current practices
* Manage essential HR filings (EEO\-1, ACA, W\-2\).
* Ensure ongoing compliance with labor and employment laws, adjusting policies and practices accordingly.
* Support mandatory training programs, including sexual harassment prevention and state\-specific workplace laws.


Other HR Responsibilities

* Assist with ad\-hoc HR projects.
* Performs other duties as assigned that are reasonably within scope of this position.

**Here’s a list of critical competencies to be successful in this role:**

* Emotional Intelligence and Interpersonal Skills: Uses self\-awareness, empathy, and active listening to build trust and expertly navigate sensitive situations.
* Detail\-Oriented: Ensures meticulous accuracy in all HR recordkeeping, compliance, and policy reviews.
* Communication: Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally across all levels of the organization.
* Problem Solving: Identifies the root causes of issues and develops effective, lasting solutions to improve processes.
* Naturally Curious: Proactively researches best practices and stays updated on evolving HR laws.
* Technology Proficiency: Proficient in standard office applications, with a forward\-thinking approach to leveraging AI tools to streamline HR workflows and improve efficiency.
* Professionalism and Discretion: Handles sensitive employee information with absolute integrity and confidentiality.

**Our minimum requirements include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management or a related field. Willing to accept a combination of an associate degree \+ work experience or equivalent work experience.
* Two years of professional work experience in Human Resources.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
* Must demonstrate a strong ability to problem solve.
* Must demonstrate high emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.

**Work environment:**


Modeans are able to work remotely at any location within Virginia, Tennessee, or North Carolina, unless as otherwise required by job responsibilities. Employees may occasionally need to travel to our office in Blacksburg, VA or other locations for items such as training or company meetings. We will also provide employees with tools to do their job at home as well as in the office.  

  

**Estimated Salary Range:** $55,000 \- $80,000\. The posted range represents the employer’s good\-faith estimate of the breadthofthecompensation for this position at the time of posting, basedonapplicablefactors. Actual starting compensation may vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, specific skills, internal equity considerations, and business needs.

**Physical Demands:**


Must be able to remain in a stationary position during the duration of the workday. Individuals must have the ability to constantly operate a computer. Must have the ability to converse with and exchange information to clients and coworkers both in person and through a computer. Capable of occasionally transporting items of 10 lbs or less to and from the office.


You must be legally authorized to work in the United States for this position.


Modea participates in the E\-Verify program.

Modea is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.


We aspire to be an highly inclusive employer – providing fair and appropriate opportunities to as many people from different backgrounds as possible, being welcoming and meeting their needs as best we can. new_jobs.title: Operations Specialist - Customer Operations Support
new_jobs.description:
At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech\-forward, growth driven culture. With 85\+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably.
  
We're looking for bold thinkers, builders, technologists, and sellers who want real ownership of their work, thrive in collaborative environments, and are energized by solving complex challenges. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact \- fast.
  
If you're eager to shape the future of cross\-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.
  
  

What you will get to do as an Operations Specialist
  
  

* Act as the primary point of contact for MoneyGram’s partners, resolving complex issues related to reconciliation, research, risk, compliance, and customer inquiries, while managing the account base to meet department expectations.
* Oversee the reconciliation of unmatched settlements for assigned financial institutions, ensuring timely resolution of discrepancies and compliance with daily priorities related to key accounts and MoneyGram relationships.
* Research and analyze item exceptions for customers and the department, resolving them within service level agreements, minimizing financial risk, and maintaining accurate documentation for auditing purposes.
* Serve as the key contact for financial institutions, addressing high\-dollar adjustments, reconciling complex accounts, and mitigating financial impact through effective resolution of discrepancies across internal systems and settlement files.
* Collaborate with internal teams (sales, product, etc.) and external partners to identify and implement process improvements, driving operational efficiencies and enhancing service delivery.
* Manage inventory levels at agent and supplier/warehouse locations, assign inventory ranges to agents, track destroyed or lost stock, assist with training new employees, and ensure outsourced functions meet SLAs and quality assurance standards.


What you will need to be successful
  
  

* High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or related field preferred.\\
* 4\+ years of experience in bank operations, partner support, or financial services.
* Experience in settlement reconciliation, inventory management, and troubleshooting technical issues.
* Previous experience with MoneyGram products, POS systems, or financial institutions preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex financial issues.
* Experience with reconciliation processes, financial reporting, and settlement systems.
* Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders across multiple channels (phone, email, chat).
* Detail\-oriented with strong documentation and audit trail management skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and other financial systems and applications.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and work under tight deadlines.
* Strong understanding of financial regulations, audit requirements, and risk mitigation practices.
* Experience in driving process improvements and system efficiency.


The salary/pay rate listed below is a good faith determination that may be offered to a successful applicant for this position at the time of this job advertisement based on the company hiring process and budget for this role and may be modified in the future. Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, and/or skill level.
  
Here Are Some Reasons You Will Love Working At MoneyGram!
  
* Remote first flexibility
* Generous PTO
* 13 Paid Holidays
* Medical / Dental / Vision Insurance
* Life, Disability, and other benefits
* 401k with competitive Employer Match
* Community Service Days
* Generous Parental Leave


MoneyGram does not sponsor US work authorizations for this job position including H\-1Bs, O\-1, and TN. MoneyGram also does not hire F\-1s working on EAD for this position.
  
About MoneyGram
  
MoneyGram is a global payments network built to move money across borders with speed, simplicity and trust. Its omnichannel platform empowers consumers, developers and agents to transfer cash, fiat and stablecoin however it works best for them.
  
The company serves over 60 million customers a year across 200\+ countries and territories, nearly half a million retail locations and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem reaching billions of devices. As one of the most recognized and trusted names in global payments, MoneyGram continues to reinvent how money moves \- helping people around the world support their loved ones and build better futures.
  
MoneyGram is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist - Transmission GIS
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview  
At Intellezy, we are an award\-winning change management and learning and development (L\&D) firm dedicated to partnering with organizations across the U.S. to ensure successful technology adoption and implementation. Our team of highly\-skilled industry experts delivers innovative training solutions that foster lasting change and growth.

Job Overview

We are seeking a **Learning \& Development Specialist** with deep GIS expertise to design, develop, and deliver training for a **Transmission GIS** initiative. This role combines advanced instructional design and training development capabilities with strong technical knowledge of **Esri GIS systems**.

The successful candidate must bring **subject matter expert\-level knowledge of GIS systems**. Experience with Esri is strongly preferred, with familiarity or expertise in the **Utility Network (UN)** particularly valuable. This technical GIS expertise is an essential requirement of the role.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality training content supporting Transmission GIS systems, processes, and workflows.
* Apply instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles to create effective, engaging learning experiences.
* Develop instructor\-led training materials, participant resources, job aids, reference materials, and other learning assets as needed.
* Translate complex GIS concepts and technical processes into clear, accessible training content for end users.
* Partner with business stakeholders, technical SMEs, and project team members to identify learning needs and validate training content.
* Facilitate instructor\-led training sessions and support learners through system and process changes.
* Participate in both the **design and execution** of the overall training program.
* Incorporate feedback, system updates, and changing business requirements into training materials.
* Ensure learning deliverables meet established quality standards and project timelines.

Qualifications

* **SME\-level expertise in GIS systems is required.** This is an essential qualification for the position.
* Demonstrated experience with **Esri GIS systems** is required/preferred based on depth of overall GIS expertise, with **Utility Network (UN)** experience highly preferred.
* Advanced instructional design experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to independently create technical training content and learning materials.
* Experience in both the design and delivery/execution of training programs.
* Advanced facilitation and presentation skills preferred.
* Familiarity with **Transmission GIS** environments is strongly preferred.
* Experience with both **underground and overhead transmission** is preferred.
* Strong ability to translate highly technical information into learner\-friendly training.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, collaboration, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience preferred.

Location \& Travel

Candidates located in **New England are preferred**; however, due to the specialized GIS expertise required for this role, qualified candidates throughout the United States are encouraged to apply.

This role is expected to require approximately **30% travel**, primarily for in\-person training delivery. Approved business travel expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company travel policies.

Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* SME\-level expertise in GIS systems: 3 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Required)

Work Location: Remote
